name: Tanúhegyek Trail 7 / 21 / 42
description: The Tanúhegyek Trail is a trail-running race organized by the Terepfutó Műhely Sports Association in one of the most beautiful parts of the Balaton Uplands National Park, in Badacsonytomaj. Participants can choose from 7, 21, and 42 km distances, taking on 1, 3, or 5 witness hills, with wonderful views of Lake Balaton and the surrounding countryside. The start and finish are at Halászkert. The race also supports a charitable cause: participants can donate their timing chip deposit to the Üröm Animal Shelter. A dog race is also held over the shortest distance. Everyone is warmly welcome at the event on November 14, 2026.
course_highlights: Trail running in the Balaton Uplands National Park
Breathtaking views of Lake Balaton and the countryside in its autumn colors
Routes taking in 1, 3, or 5 witness hills
additional: Timing is electronic, using a chip. The chip deposit is 2,000 HUF, which is refundable or can be donated to charity. Unannounced checkpoints may be placed along the course. A dog race is also held over the shortest distance. The race does not close public roads, so traffic rules must be observed. Distances: 7 km, 21 km, 42 km; dog race over 7 km; charitable event supported through donations of timing chip deposits.

description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Race is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes several races over distances of 15 km, 7 km and 3 km, as well as a race for families, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Participants can enjoy a natural, scenic and healthy setting, away from paved roads.
course_highlights: Route along the cool trails of Hoia Forest
Various distances: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and a family race
Event held in nature, away from paved roads
additional: The event includes a registration package with a T-shirt and race number. Races are held for all ages, including one dedicated to families. The route follows natural forest trails, offering a running experience in nature. The race starts in the evening, creating a special night-race atmosphere. The participation fee includes a medal, timing and medical assistance. Registration is exclusively online, with entries open until June 13, 2026.

name: CROSUL 15 NOIEMBRIE
description: The 15 November Run is an annual sporting event held in Brașov, commemorating the Anti-Communist Revolt of 15 November 1987 by workers at the Roman Truck Factory. The main event is a 5-kilometre road race along the historic route of the revolt, open to all running enthusiasts. There are also races for children, with distances adapted to their ages, promoting physical activity and team spirit. The event is organized by Brașov City Hall in partnership with the 15 November 1987 Brașov Association and the Together for Movement Sports Club.
course_highlights: A historic 5 km route along the streets associated with the 1987 Brașov Revolt
An urban road route through Brașov, including historic and cultural landmarks
Children’s races from 250 m to 1.2 km, adapted for different age groups
additional: Registration is free and limited to 1,800 participants (1,500 adults and 300 children). Race kits can be collected the day before at the Sport Guru Brașov store between 15:30 and 20:00. The race starts inside the SC Roman industrial park, right outside the former Section 440 of the Truck Factory, where the revolt began. Running on the streets of Brașov, a 5 km route, races for all ages, commemorative event, organized in November 2025

name: Emenski Canyon Run
description: Emenski Canyon Run 2026 is a mountain running event held in the village of Emen, Veliko Tarnovo Province. The race offers three courses of varying distance and elevation gain: 8 km with 360 m of positive elevation gain, 16 km with 720 m, and 24 km with 1,100 m. Participants can enjoy marked trails, aid stations, and professional timing. The event includes a medal and souvenir for all finishers, as well as race photos.
course_highlights: Three courses of 8 km, 16 km, and 24 km
Mountain terrain with 360 to 1,100 metres of positive elevation gain
Marked trails and aid stations along the route
additional: Registration and race-pack collection from 08:00 to 11:00. Technical briefing at 10:20 at the start. Starts: 24 km at 10:30, 16 km at 11:00, and 8 km at 11:45. A medal and souvenir for all finishers. Timing and a race bib for all participants. Race photography. Trail running across different distances, registration, medals, aid stations, and technical information for participants.

name: Маратон Бургас
price_range: от 10 до 50 EUR в зависимост от избраната дистанцията и периода
description:
Burgas Marathon 2026 awaits you on November 15 for an unforgettable run!

Whether you’re chasing a new personal best, preparing for your first half marathon, or simply want to share the excitement of sport with your family and friends, Burgas Marathon offers a distance for everyone.

Choose your challenge:

42.195 km Marathon | 21.097 km Half Marathon | 10.5 km | 5 km |
1 km Decathlon Fun Run – for children, families, and everyone who wants to be part of the running celebration

The course runs along the sea and past iconic locations in Burgas, combining a fast route, beautiful views, and an incredible atmosphere. Participants from Bulgaria and abroad, dozens of volunteers, music, support along the course, and that unforgettable feeling when you cross the finish line await you.

Choose your distance, register, and become part of the event that brings people together through sport, movement, and a love of an active lifestyle.

Burgas Marathon – Run with the pulse of Burgas!

name: XL kmrun - Бонсови поляни
description: XL kmrun – Bonsovi Polyani is a November race in the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place in the Lyulin Mountain area and the iconic Bonsovi Polyani locality on the outskirts of Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances—short, medium, and long—allowing runners with different levels of preparation and ambitions to take part. The event is part of a series of races offering varied courses and running conditions in the natural surroundings of Sofia.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Lyulin Mountain area and the Bonsovi Polyani locality
A choice of three distances—short, medium, and long
A natural, iconic location on the outskirts of Sofia
additional: The race will take place in a natural setting with mountainous terrain; registration details and fees have not been specified. The date is November 22, 2026.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly running race made up of optional laps in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint. The half-marathon distance is covered by completing four laps. Participants may run as many laps as they wish. The suggested entry fee is 500 Ft per lap to help cover the race costs. All participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine, and receive a commemorative medal; the top three men and women also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and registration takes place on site.
course_highlights: The course is in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint
The half-marathon distance is covered in 4 laps
Participants may run as many laps as they wish
additional: Registration is on site, with a suggested voluntary entry fee of 500 Ft per lap. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. After the race, participants are offered hot tea, mulled wine and apples. Four laps make up the half-marathon; participants may run fewer laps. On-site registration; refreshments included.

name: Zapad Fruške Gore 2026
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a competitive and recreational sporting event held on Fruška Gora, known for its historic trails and new challenges. The event features various courses, including an ultra-extreme marathon, an ultra marathon, and medium and short courses suited to runners of different abilities. It brings together nature and running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience amid the beautiful landscapes of Fruška Gora. The organizers aim to provide good organization and support for participants throughout the event.
course_highlights: Ultra Extreme Marathon with 5 ITRA points
Middle Eastern Marathon with 3 ITRA points
Apprentice Southern Marathon with 1 ITRA point
additional: Transport to the marathon start from Novi Sad is organized for Saturday from 6:00. On-site registration for the FUN courses is available at Popovica on Saturday. Race packets are collected before the race. The races are scored under the ITRA system across different courses. Participants can expect various race categories, including ultra, medium, and beginner courses, with online registration available. The event is part of a wider festival promoting sport and nature on Fruška Gora.

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a mountain running event celebrating Romania on National Day, held in Cluj-Napoca. In its 9th edition in 2026, the event offers a variety of routes, including a 50 km ultramarathon, team races, a half marathon, a cross-country race, and children’s races. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions while enjoying scenic landscapes and a friendly atmosphere. The main 50 km route passes through natural and urban areas, with well-organized hydration and refreshment stations. The event also includes a live broadcast, modern facilities, and prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: The Ultra 50k route passes through forests, urban areas, and ski slopes around Cluj
Hydration and refreshment stations offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and sweets
The final 12 km are predominantly downhill, with just one climb of more than 100 m
additional: The runner’s kit includes a race bib with timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a finisher’s medal, and access to hydration and refreshment stations offering sweet and savory products, still and sparkling water, isotonic drinks, supplements, and fruit. A refund policy is available if announced by November 9, 2026. Time limits are 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. The event also includes Play&Run children’s races and an awards ceremony at 15:00. Race distances include Ultra 50k, Half 25k, Cross 15k, Mini EcoTrail 7k, and children’s races; events take place from November 28 to December 1, 2026, with exhibitions, kit distribution, and awards ceremonies.

name: MARATON 1 DECEMBRIE
description: The 1 December Marathon is an annual competition held in IOR Park in Bucharest, open to runners of all levels. The event offers an enjoyable sporting experience, with well-organized courses and a friendly atmosphere. Participants can receive race kits and attentive organizational support, helping ensure a safe and motivating race. The marathon also supports charitable causes, bringing the community together for a worthy purpose.
course_highlights: Course held in IOR Park, Bucharest
Race kits handed directly to participants or to a representative with the required documents
Race kit collection available over the three days before the race
additional: Race kits can be collected over the three days before the race at locations in Bucharest: SportGuru Store (69 Unirii Boulevard) and ParkLake Shopping Center. Kits are handed only to the registered and validated participant, upon presentation of an identity document. Another person may collect a kit only with a signed copy of the participant’s identity document. For the teenagers’ race, the kit is handed only to the minor, accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who signs a declaration of physical and medical fitness. Participation includes races for different categories and supports charitable causes; the event has a tradition of promoting an active and healthy lifestyle.

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a landmark event celebrating Romania on National Day, offering runners a unique trail-running experience in the picturesque landscapes around Cluj. Now in its 9th edition, the main Ultra 50k race is a favorite among trail runners for the challenge and beauty of its course, which includes forests and spectacular climbs and descents. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions, and the atmosphere is friendly and festive, with well-stocked aid stations and personalized finisher medals. The event also includes races for all ages and levels, from Mini EcoTrail to team races.
course_highlights: A 50 km course with climbs and descents through the forests around Cluj
Checkpoints and hydration stations offering a variety of refreshments (water, isotonic drinks, fruit, sweets, and savory food)
Views above Cluj-Napoca and iconic areas such as Borhanci, the Poarta de su’ Feleac Museum, and the Feleacu ski slopes
additional: The race kit includes a race bib with a timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a personalized finisher medal, and access to aid stations serving sweet and savory foods, isotonic drinks, and fruit. There are children’s races and team races with special rules on the spacing between members. Cut-off times: 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. Refund insurance is included if announced by November 9. Participants can support various historical regions of Romania and enjoy varied routes, from trail to cross-country, with registration open and early-bird prices available.

name: ADVENTI JÓTÉKONY FUTÁS
description: The Advent Charity Run is a welcoming, family-friendly running event in Bölcske, where participants can test their abilities over 3 or 6 kilometers. Part of the entry fee goes to charity, making the event not only a sporting activity but also a chance to help others. It is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners looking to enjoy a pleasant winter running event.
course_highlights: Choose between 3 km and 6 km
A family-friendly running event supporting charity
Set in the natural surroundings of Bölcske
additional: HUF 500 from each entry fee goes to charity. Runners can choose whether to take part in the 3 km or 6 km event. Family registration is also available for the 2 km distance, for up to 4 participants. The event supports charitable causes, payment of the entry fee is mandatory, and participation is open to all ages. The run takes place at 1435/6 Csorda út, Bölcske.

name: ADVENTI KOCOGÓ
description: The Advent Jog is a charity running event held at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre in Kecskemét. The aim is to raise donations for the NM Foundation for the Recovery of Muscles, supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, including Marci Nemes. The event offers participants a sense of community and an active experience while serving a worthy cause. The organizers thank all the runners and volunteers who contributed to its success.
course_highlights: The run takes place at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre
A charity event supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy
A community-focused sporting experience for families and runners
additional: Volunteers also help behind the scenes at the event. The run is organized for charity, supporting the local foundation and children with the condition. It is part of the Advent season; the run supports the recovery of sick children and is traditionally held every year to bring the community together.

name: OVB Charity RUN
description: OVB Charity Run is a charity race organized in Cluj-Napoca, dedicated to runners of all levels who want to support a worthy cause through sport. The event offers an enjoyable running experience in a friendly setting, promoting the local running community and social engagement. This is the first edition of the race, inviting participants to enjoy running and contribute to the common good.
course_highlights: 6 km course in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca
Supports the 'Saint Nectarios' Palliative Care Center for seriously ill children
Race options of 2 km (family, non-competitive) and 6 km (competitive)
additional: Participants can register until December 5, 2025; the event takes place in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca, and supports the pediatric cause through donations and sponsorships.

name: Gučevo winter trail 2026
location: Planinarski dom PK Gučevo, Mount Gučevo, Serbia
description: Gučevo Winter Trail 2026 is a mountain race held on Mount Gučevo, starting near the PK Gučevo Mountain Lodge. The race is challenging, with 700 metres of total elevation gain and 700 metres of descent over a 13 km course. Participants can enjoy the natural scenery and demanding terrain, which tests endurance and running technique. The start is scheduled for 11:00, and the organizers emphasize the importance of following the rules and staying safe during the race.
course_highlights: 13 km course with 700 m of total elevation gain and 700 m of descent
Mountain terrain on Mount Gučevo
Checkpoints at 6 km and at the finish at 13 km
additional: Registration requires confirmation that participants have read and understood the race regulations and risks, as well as permission to use photos and videos from the race. Registration includes consent to participate at one’s own risk and acceptance of the regulations and rules of conduct.

name: STOP-MIKULÁS FUTÁS
description: The Stop Santa Claus Run is a traditional, family-friendly running race in Tatabánya, held for the 33rd time in 2025. The event features three distances: 200 metres for young children, and 1,900 and 5,900 metres for adults and older runners. More than 200 people took part, each receiving a unique finisher’s medal, and Santa’s gifts await the youngest participants. The race has a welcoming, family atmosphere, with the organisers presenting numerous prizes and special awards. Participants can also celebrate those with December birthdays with cake and pastries.
course_highlights: Three distances: 200 m, 1,900 m and 5,900 m
Unique finisher’s medal for the 1,900 m and 5,900 m distances
Family-friendly atmosphere, with gifts from Santa for the children
additional: Runners over 70 are honoured with certificates, and the sportiest families receive a special award. The event’s main sponsors are Tatabányai SC and Stop Cukrászda, which treats participants to cake and pastries. The oldest participant completed the longest distance at the age of 87. Community support, an awards ceremony, gifts and a cheerful winter running celebration.

name: XL kmrun - Северен парк
description: XL kmrun - North Park is a race on the 5kmrun calendar, held in North Park, Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances—6 km, 12 km, and 18 km—suitable for different levels of fitness. The event offers the opportunity to run in a natural setting on varied terrain and is part of the XLkmrun series of races held at various locations around Sofia. It is a traditional winter race that attracts runners from the city and the surrounding region.
course_highlights: Three distances: 6 km, 12 km, and 18 km
Terrain with alternating climbs and descents
Held in North Park, Sofia
additional: The distances allow participants to choose according to their abilities and preferred level of exertion. The race is part of the XLkmrun winter calendar and takes place in conditions suitable for winter running.

name: Everesting+ Ultra Zărand
description: Ultra Zarand Everesting+ is an extreme mountain running race held in Căsoaia, Arad County, Romania, on 11-12 December 2026. The event offers two challenging distances: 172 km with 9,250 m of elevation gain, rated difficult, and 86 km with 4,600 m of elevation gain, rated intermediate. The race is known for its demanding mountain terrain and Everesting challenge, making it suitable for experienced runners seeking a top-level endurance competition. Participants can track their performance on a personalized results dashboard.
course_highlights: Distances of 86 km and 172 km with 4,600 m and 9,250 m of elevation gain, respectively
Mountain terrain rated intermediate and difficult
Everesting event with extreme endurance challenges
additional: The event has a personalized dashboard for tracking participants’ results. No entry-fee details or start times are provided. The race has a UTMB index for both distances, indicating international recognition of its difficulty. The event also includes a 10 km race to promote local tourism and natural and cultural heritage, offering a unique opportunity for ultramarathon and mountain running enthusiasts.

description: Deliblatska Peščara 2026 is a one-day hiking event organized by PSK Pobeda, held in the beautiful surroundings of Deliblatska Peščara near Čardak. Participants can choose between two hiking groups, with routes ranging from 8 to 16 kilometers through rolling landscapes of sand dunes and woodland. The route is easy, with negligible elevation gain, and is suitable for people with light to moderate fitness levels. After the hike, participants can take a break and enjoy an organized lunch with hot soup and refreshments. This event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and spend time together in the spirit of mountaineering.
course_highlights: Routes through rolling landscapes of sand dunes and woodland
Two hiking groups: 15–16 km or 8–10 km
Easy route with negligible elevation gain
additional: Departure is at 7:30 from Nebojšina Street, by the Church of Saint Sava. Recommended gear includes protection from wind, rain, and cold; sturdy hiking boots; layered clothing; a thermos or water bottle (minimum 1 liter); a flashlight; and hiking poles. Advance notice and registration with the guide are required for the organized lunch. Return to Belgrade is planned between 18:30 and 19:00. Participants must bring their hiking membership card, health insurance card, and ID card. The guide assigns bus seats in the order participants register and pay. Hiking through Deliblatska Peščara requires appropriate gear, registration with fee, and participant responsibility.

name: Semimaraton „Pe Argeș în Jos”
description: The “Pe Argeș în Jos” Half Marathon is an annual sporting event held in the heart of Pitești, bringing together runners of all levels. The courses start in Ștrand Park, pass through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks, and continue along the Argeș River promenade, offering a distinctive natural and urban setting for running. The event includes races for all ages and fitness levels, from children’s races to the 21 km half marathon, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The atmosphere is vibrant, with supporters, music, and prizes for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Ștrand Park, near the Summer Theatre
Course through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks
Run along the Argeș River promenade, with picturesque views
additional: Race kit collection is on December 12 at EF Store and on December 14 at the Summer Theatre for participants from outside Pitești. The half marathon, 5 km, and 10 km races start at 10:00 in Ștrand Park. The children’s race starts at 12:30, and the awards ceremony is at 13:00. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal representative when registering and collecting their race kit. The event includes online registration, race kit collection on 12.12.2026, and access to results and photos after the event.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly running event with optional laps, held in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint. Runners can complete the half-marathon distance in four laps, or choose to run fewer laps. The event has a welcoming atmosphere, with apples, hot tea and mulled wine for participants. Every entrant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00, and registration is on-site, with a suggested voluntary entry fee.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Dióskert area of Törökbálint
The half-marathon consists of 4 laps, but runners can choose to complete fewer
A friendly, community atmosphere with apples, hot tea and mulled wine
additional: Registration is on-site, with a suggested voluntary entry fee of 500 Ft per lap. Every entrant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women receive a special medal. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. Apples, hot tea and mulled wine are provided for participants. Runners can choose to complete fewer laps. On-site registration, refreshments and commemorative medals are provided. The event supports the community and local runners.

name: 7. Winter Trail Race na Fruškoj gori
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a traditional sports, competitive, and recreational event held on Fruška Gora. The race features a variety of courses, from ultra-extreme to beginner, with challenging climbs and beautiful natural surroundings. Participants can enjoy the challenges and beauty of the mountain terrain while competing in a unique atmosphere. The event brings together runners of all levels and promotes a healthy lifestyle and a love of nature.
course_highlights: Varied courses with 1 to 5 ITRA points
Mountain terrain with significant climbs and descents
Beautiful landscapes and natural surroundings of Fruška Gora
additional: Races are scored under the ITRA system, with different difficulty categories (1 to 5 ITRA points). The event includes ultra-extreme, ultra, medium, short, and beginner marathons. The beginner Southern Marathon is 22 km long, with 898 m of ascent and descent. Group and fun registration options are also available for the shorter courses. The event takes place in April, and the 7th Winter Trail Race on Fruška Gora is held in December. Participation includes courses of various lengths, and the event is part of a series of races on Fruška Gora, focused on trail and mountain sports. Registration details are not available.

description: Malacvágta is a recreational pre-New Year’s Eve running race taking place on December 30, 2024, at Bókay Garden in Budapest. Several age groups can take part, including junior, adult, senior and veteran categories, and there is also a stroller race. Participation is free, and every runner receives a free T-shirt, making this a friendly, family-oriented event.
course_highlights: 6,000-metre race for junior, adult, senior and veteran categories
3,000-metre stroller race
The race venue is Bókay Garden, Budapest
additional: Every runner receives a free T-shirt. The event has two races: a 6,000 m race for junior, adult, senior and veteran categories at 12:20, and a 3,000 m stroller race at 13:00. The venue is Bókay Garden; race times are 11:35 and 13:40. The event is part of the year-end community programme.

name: GÚTAI VÍZKERESZT MARATON, FÉLMARATON
organizer: Maratón klub Kolárovo – Maraton klub Gúta
description: A Gútai Vízkreszt Maraton és Félmaraton egy hagyományos téli futóverseny Szlovákiában, Kolárovo városában. A verseny januárban kerül megrendezésre, és a résztvevők a város főteréről indulnak, ágyúlövés jelzi a rajtot. A futók egy változatos útvonalon haladnak, amely a város és környéke utcáin vezet, és a verseny során a szél és a hideg időjárás is kihívást jelenthet. A rendezvényt a Maraton Klub Kolárovo - Maraton Klub Gúta szervezi, és a nevezési díjakat előre banki átutalással kell rendezni. A résztvevőknek 18 év felettieknek kell lenniük a maratonon, és 16 év felettieknek a félmaratonon.

name: TIHANY TRAIL
location: Tihanyi Bencés Iskola, Csokonai utca 73, Tihany, Hungary
description: Tihany Trail is a winter trail-running and Nordic walking race held on varied, challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of the Balaton Uplands. The course is especially distinctive because participants run along the rim of the caldera and on a rocky cliff edge, making for an exciting and scenic race. Participants can choose from 5, 10 and 15 km distances, and aid stations provide hydration and energy. This is a real treat for trail runners, attracting running enthusiasts even in winter.
course_highlights: Varied, challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of the Balaton Uplands
Running along the rim of the caldera, on a rocky cliff edge and along narrow trails
Aid stations with water, energy drink, glucose tablets and salted pretzels
additional: Race-pack collection takes place from 8:00 to 9:50, followed by a warm-up with Gabi Piros at 9:50. Refreshments are available at two points on the course and at the event centre. There will be no cups at the aid stations, so participants must bring a flask or cup. On the 15 km course, the first aid station is at the Forest School (approximately 6.9 km) and the second is beside the Apáti Church (approximately 10.3 km). <i:am> mineral+ energy drink and cherry-flavoured hypotonic drink are also available on the course. Trail-running shoes are recommended, with anti-slip aids if needed; road-running shoes are not suitable for the terrain. The race starts at 10:30. The event centre is at Tihanyi Bencés Iskola, Tihany, Csokonai u. 73. The organisers recommend trail-running shoes and, if needed, anti-slip aids. Participants must bring their own cup or flask for the aid stations.

name: ORADEA CITY TRAIL RUN
location: Parcul Ion C. Brătianu, Oradea, Romania
organizer: Asociaţia Clubul Sportiv Xterra Sport Bihor
description: Oradea City Trail is a running competition held in Ion C. Brătianu Park in Oradea, offering three routes: half marathon, cross, and mini. The event is for runners of all ages, with clearly defined age categories, and emphasizes sportsmanship and the outdoor experience. Participants receive personalized race kits and finisher medals, while the top finishers are awarded prizes by category. The race starts in the morning, and the routes are clearly marked, with refreshment points along the way.
course_highlights: 21 km half-marathon route with a time limit of 3.5 hours
10.5 km cross route with a time limit of 2 hours
Start and finish in Ion C. Brătianu Park, Oradea
additional: Race confirmation and race-pack pickup take place on race day between 07:00 and 09:30 in IC Brătianu Park. The technical briefing is at 09:30, before the start. The half-marathon route has three refreshment points, while the cross/mini route has one. Participants must wear their race number visibly on their clothing. Trail-running shoes are recommended. Minors must have parental consent.

The competition offers two main routes—the short “Zaeka” and the long “Cherni Vrah”—which start at 09:17. This winter sports event attracts ski and snowboard enthusiasts, offering challenging courses in a mountain setting. Participants can enjoy Vitosha’s beautiful scenery and mountain air.
course_highlights: “Zaeka” course – short course
“Cherni Vrah” course – long course
Held in Vitosha Nature Park, around Aleko Hut

description: The Oxygen Cup is a winter running series in Debrecen’s Nagyerdő, offering middle- and long-distance runners and amateur athletes the opportunity to compete. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, while providing opportunities to race during the winter. The course runs along the trails of Nagyerdő, which have a runner- and joint-friendly surface and provide an ideal setting for participants. The series is traditionally very popular, and participants include both amateurs and registered athletes.

name: Национален крос "По стъпките на Васил Левски" 2026
location: Garden next to National School of Applied Arts “Prof. Venko Kolev”, Troyan, Bulgaria
description: The National Cross-Country Race “In the Footsteps of Vasil Levski” is an annual event honoring the memory of the Apostle, with participants covering part of the route he once traveled. The race takes place in Troyan, starting near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts. Several distances of varying difficulty and elevation are offered for different age and gender groups. The event combines sporting spirit with historical remembrance and is open to anyone wishing to honor Vasil Levski’s legacy.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 8 km, and 12 km, with elevation gains ranging from 10 m to 375 m
The course follows paths traveled by Vasil Levski
The start is near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan
additional: Registration is open until 09.02.2026. Members of the Bulgarian Orienteering Federation submit entries at https://orienteering.bg, while those who are not registered can submit entries by email or phone. Bib numbers can be collected from the secretariat by 11:00, and on-site registration is possible until 10:30 if bib numbers are available. The youngest participants (3 km) are transported by minibus to the starting point and run along red markings. The Masters start (12 km) is at 11:20, following yellow markings. For the 2026 edition, the start is listed at 11:00 from the garden near the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan; advance entries are accepted, and on-site registration is possible if bib numbers are available. The date listed in the 2026 sources is 14 February, not 20 February 2027.

The event is part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship and offers participation opportunities for various rider categories. The race starts at 09:30, and detailed information and regulations are available on the federation’s official website. Registration is online via a special link provided by the organizers.

Part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship
Various participant categories

Organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club, the event brings together runners who enjoy nature and the challenges of mountain terrain. The race is known for its demanding yet beautiful route through wooded areas, offering an opportunity for both a sporting challenge and camaraderie. The fifth edition of the race is scheduled for March 13, 2027.
course_highlights: Mountain trail on Avala
Wooded areas and natural surroundings
Challenging terrain with climbs
additional: The fifteenth edition of the race is organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club from Belgrade. Around 70 participants have registered for 2027 so far. Photographer Nemanja Jovanović is covering the event. Participants can expect medals, T-shirts, and professional timing. The race is part of an annual tradition of events on Avala.

Organized by the Sarnena Gora Cycling and Tourism Club with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality, the event features Ultra Trail Run and XCM Cycling disciplines. name: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo
organizer: Спортен клуб по планинско бягане и туризъм „Пловдив и Родопа“
description: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo is a mountain running race held in the foothills of the Rhodope Mountains around the village of Markovo, Plovdiv Province. The race offers four distances—8, 12, 22, and 44 km—as well as a 700-meter children’s course. Participants can enjoy well-marked and secured courses with aid stations providing water, food, and drinks. Race services include timing, electronic results tracking, medical assistance, and special race packs with gifts. The event is held under the auspices of Markovo Town Hall and organized by the Plovdiv and Rhodopa Mountain Running and Tourism Sports Clubs.

name: Kablar Skyrace 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held on the slopes of Kablar in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge. The race is 22.4 km long, with 1,600 metres of cumulative elevation gain, and is worth 1 ITRA point. The course combines fast sections through forests, technically challenging rocky segments, and climbs to two peaks of Kablar, offering beautiful views of the West Morava and surrounding mountains. The race is intended both for beginners in mountain running and experienced runners who want to enjoy the nature of western Serbia. It is organized by the "Kablar" Mountaineering Society of Čačak under the auspices of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia.
course_highlights: 22.4 km with 1,600 m of cumulative elevation gain
Technically challenging rocky sections and two Kablar peaks (889 and 885 m)
Views of the West Morava, Ovčar, Jelica, and Debela Gora
additional: The race has a four-hour time limit for competitors in the PSS National Series. The course is certified and is worth 1 ITRA point. The start and finish are at the Nature Center in Ovčar Banja. The organizer provides good race management, clear course markings, and safety throughout the race. The 2026 edition started and finished at the Nature Center in Ovčar Banja; it is listed as certified for 1 ITRA point. That page lists the date as April 4, 2026, not April 10, 2027.

Participants can choose between 11 km, 27 km, and 43 km mountain courses with varying elevation gain, passing through picturesque natural landscapes. The event includes professional organization, marked courses, aid stations, and medals for all finishers. It is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the magic of the mountains and enjoy sport and nature together.

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail running race held in Băneasa Forest in Bucharest. It has grown organically since its first edition in 2018, reaching more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: half marathon (21 km), cross-country (11 km), sprint (6 km), and Family Run (3 km), so every runner can find the right challenge. The varied courses include trails, dirt roads, and asphalt, offering an enjoyable experience in nature, with well-positioned refreshment stations. Băneasa Forest Run is about the joy of running in the forest, whether you run competitively or for fun with your family.
course_highlights: 100% trail routes in Băneasa Forest, with trails, dirt roads, and asphalt
A range of distances: half marathon 21 km, cross-country 11 km, sprint 6 km, and Family Run 3 km
Refreshment stations at the start, km 3.3, km 5, km 9, and the finish, with water, isotonic drink, and food
additional: The routes may include elevation changes, roots, and vegetation; rain may bring puddles and mud. Group training sessions are organized for different paces, with coordinators. Refreshment stations along the routes offer water, isotonic drink, and food.

name: Cheile Turzii Race
location: Rezervația Naturală Cheile Turzii, Cluj County, Romania
description: Cheile Turzii Race is a mountain running competition held in the heart of Transylvania, in the Cheile Turzii Nature Reserve, Romania. The event offers two races: a 9 km cross-country race with 680 m of elevation gain and a 23 km half marathon with 1,300 m of elevation gain, on technical and spectacular routes featuring dramatic scenery and mountain trails. Participants can experience running beneath limestone cliffs, crossing bridges over the Hășdate River, and climbing to impressive panoramic viewpoints. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners seeking authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Technical routes on mountain trails and forest roads
Spectacular scenery featuring limestone cliffs and dramatic gorges
Climb to Crucea Sănduleștilor with 360° views of the Apuseni Mountains
additional: The start and finish are in front of the Cheile Turzii Mountain Rescue Base. The race kit includes a customized fabric drawstring bag and a finisher medal; the technical T-shirt or singlet is purchased separately. There are aid and hydration stations along the route with water, cola, isotonic drink, fruit, and snacks. Race kits can be collected on Friday, April 17, between 16:00 and 20:00 in Cluj-Napoca (Iulius Mall), and at Cheile Turzii between 19:00 and 21:00, with collection also available on race morning. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:30 at the Mihai Viteazu Town Hall Cabin. Mountain routes, two races, tourism promotion, maximum 400 participants.

name: Maratonul Argonauților
description: Maratonul Argonauților este o competiție de alergare desfășurată în Cheile și Gura Dobrogei, o zonă pitorească din România, cu un traseu de maraton ce include o diferență pozitivă de nivel de 1600 metri. Evenimentul este organizat de Asociația Sportivă Activ Pontica și oferă participanților o experiență unică în natură, pe trasee ce promovează frumusețea rezervațiilor naturale din Dobrogea. Pe lângă maraton, se organizează și alte curse precum semimaraton, cros, cursa familiei și circuitul cheilor, adresându-se unui public larg de alergători. Maratonul are o tradiție și o poveste inspirată de Argonauți, eroii din mitologia greacă, care adaugă un farmec aparte competiției.

name: La Petrovaselo în vie
description: La Petrovaselo în vie este un eveniment sportiv dedicat alergării în natură, organizat pentru a promova un stil de viață sănătos și pentru a crește numărul practicanților de alergare în aer liber. Evenimentul, organizat de Clubul Sportiv Asociația Alergotura în parteneriat cu Petro Vaselo Winery, oferă trei curse de alergare cu distanțe variate, desfășurate pe trasee pitorești în zona viei Petro Vaselo. Participanții se pot bucura de o experiență sportivă în natură, cu trasee bine marcate și puncte de alimentare, într-un cadru prietenos și organizat. După cursă, participanții sunt invitați să se relaxeze cu gulaș și vin, oferite pe baza numărului de concurs.

name: Medieval Trail Race
description: Medieval Trail Race este o competiție de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în județul Arad, România, pe potecile turistice din Munții Zărandului, între localitățile Șoimoș și Șiria. Evenimentul promovează atât alergarea montană, cât și patrimoniul natural și istoric al zonei, legând în alergare cetățile Șoimoș și Șiria, precum și alte obiective de interes. Traseele oferă o experiență de aventură cu peisaje de primăvară și o atmosferă medievală, fiind potrivite atât pentru amatori, cât și pentru profesioniști. Ediția din 2026 este a 5-a și face parte din calendarul ITRA National League și UTMB Index.

name: Fuss a struccal 4 / 7 / 14 / 21
description: A Fuss a struccal jótékonysági futófesztivál Győrben, az Aranyparton kerül megrendezésre 2026-ban immár harmadik alkalommal. A rendezvényen több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, a legkisebbektől a legidősebbekig minden korosztály számára nyitott. A futófesztivál célja a gyermekellátás támogatása, különösen egy speciális EEG készülék beszerzése az epilepsziás és súlyos állapotú gyermekek diagnosztikájához. A rendezvényen ismert sportolók és közéleti személyiségek is részt vesznek, családias, közösségi hangulatban. A nevezési díjakból befolyt összeg a Gyermek Intenzív Terápiáért Alapítványt támogatja.

name: Vértés Terep Maraton
location: Szár, Sportcsarnok, Forrás utca . Ápr.25.-28. BACKYARD ULTRA ESZTERGOM - Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya n*
description: A Vértes Terep Maraton egy kihívásokkal teli terepfutó verseny a Vértes hegység festői ösvényein és erdészeti útjain. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget a futóknak, az ultramaratontól a minimaratonig, mindegyik változatos szintemelkedéssel és jól jelölt pályával. A rendezvény frissítőpontokkal, névre szóló rajtszámmal, időméréssel és gazdag célétellel várja a résztvevőket, akik a természet közelségét és a sportos élményt élvezhetik. A verseny családias hangulatú, és a szervezők külön figyelmet fordítanak a futók kényelmére és biztonságára.

name: Clear'97 Alpokalja Business Run
description: A Clear'97 Alpokalja Business Run egy közösségépítő, tavaszi futófesztivál Szombathelyen, amely céges, baráti és iskolai csapatok számára kínál különböző távokat egyéni és váltó kategóriákban. A verseny 2,5 km-es gyerekfutamtól indul, és 5 km, 10 km, valamint 20 km-es távokon zajlik, váltókkal kiegészítve. A rendezvény célja a sport és a mozgáskultúra népszerűsítése, egyedi befutóéremmel, elektronikus időméréssel és élő eredménykövetéssel. A versenyhez egészségnap is kapcsolódik, ahol mentálhigiénés szakemberek és terápiás bemutatók várják a résztvevőket. Ingyenes parkolás biztosított a Vasi Skanzen parkolójában.

name: XXIII. Motherson Szigetköz Félmaraton 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
description: A XXIII. Motherson Szigetköz Félmaraton egy hagyományos futóverseny Mosonmagyaróváron, amely a szabadidősport népszerűsítését szolgálja. A verseny az Olimpiai Ötpróba része, és 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, valamint félmaraton (21,1 km) távokon kínál pontszerzési lehetőséget. A rajt és cél az UFM Arénánál van, ahol öltözési, zuhanyzási és ruhatári lehetőségek állnak rendelkezésre. A versenyen chipes időmérés biztosított, és a leghosszabb távon limitidő van érvényben. A rajtszámra a nevezők neve vagy beceneve is rákerülhet, ha április 10-ig neveznek.

name: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge
description: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge este o competiție de alergare montană ce se desfășoară pe 19 aprilie 2026 în satul Dălhăuți, județul Vrancea. Evenimentul este organizat de Asociația Sportivă Velopower și promovează alergarea pe teren variat, incluzând poteci de pădure și drumuri forestiere. Participanții se pot bucura de un traseu bine marcat, cu puncte de control și o atmosferă prietenoasă, completată de o ceremonie de premiere și un prânz tradițional la final. Startul este programat la ora 10:00, după o ședință tehnică și o încălzire cu cafea. Evenimentul pune accent pe socializare și promovarea mișcării în natură.

name: Brăila 10K
description: Brăila 10K este o cursă de alergare organizată în Parcul Monument din Brăila, pe 19 aprilie 2026, care oferă o experiență energizantă și prietenoasă pentru alergători de toate vârstele. Evenimentul include curse de 10,5 km, 7 km, 3,5 km, curse pentru copii și o cursă Family Fun Run de 1,5 km, fiind ideal pentru stabilirea unui record personal pe un traseu rapid și bine marcat. Atmosfera de festival, muzica, premiile și activitățile pentru întreaga familie fac din Brăila 10K o sărbătoare a mișcării și sănătății în aer liber. Organizatorii pun accent pe siguranță și buna desfășurare a competiției, cu voluntari și arbitri prezenți pe traseu.

eBike MTB cycling at up to 27 km/h on the 38 km ultra course

name: ULTRABALATON

A verseny a Balatont megkerülő egykörös futóverseny, amely Közép-Európa leghosszabb futóversenye, és egyéniben vagy csapatban, futva vagy kerékpárral is teljesíthető. A táv 209 kilométer, amely egyéni indulóknak és 2-6 fős csapatoknak is elérhető. A rendezvény barátságos, közösségi hangulatú, és a futók mellett a kísérők és kerékpárosok számára is vonzó programokat kínál.

name: Турнир ”Цветанка Христова”
description: The Tsvetanka Khristova Tournament is an annual athletics competition held in memory of one of Bulgaria’s greatest track and field athletes. The competition is being held for the 17th time and includes the second round of the “A1 Athletics for Youth” series for young athletics talents. The tournament takes place at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia and brings together athletes of various ages and disciplines. It is an important event in Bulgarian athletics that honors Tsvetanka Khristova’s legacy and encourages the development of young talent.

name: Fruškogorski maraton
distance_verbose: 134 km, 100 km, 59 km, Maraton, Polumaraton, 10 km
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a sporting competition and recreational event with a long tradition. It takes place in the hilly, forested area of Fruška Gora, near Novi Sad. The routes pass through natural beauty spots and numerous medieval Serbian monasteries, as well as historical and cultural landmarks. The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. In addition to the competitive courses, there are nine recreational routes that promote a healthy lifestyle and nature conservation.
course_highlights: The routes pass through 97% forested terrain on Fruška Gora
Pass through medieval Serbian monasteries such as Grgeteg, Staro Hopovo, Novo Hopovo, Jazak, and Bešenovo
Climb Fruška Gora’s highest peak (539 m) and descend past the Dombovački Stream waterfall
additional: The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. There are 14 different routes of varying distances and elevation gains, ranging from an ultra-extreme 134 km marathon to recreational routes. The routes include natural and cultural landmarks, as well as historical sites. The organizer also has a Viber group for registrations and communication. 14 routes of varying distances, ITRA-certified, including ultra and recreational distances, passing medieval monasteries and natural and cultural landmarks.

name: 49th Fruška Gora Trail
location: Planinarski dom Železničar, Fruška Gora, Serbia

description: Fruška Gora Trail is a traditional sporting competition held on Fruška Gora, known for its old trails and new challenges. The race features a range of courses and categories, from ultra-extreme to recreational, suited to runners of different levels. The event brings together nature and running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience amid beautiful landscapes and demanding terrain. The organizers strive to provide quality logistics, including organized transport to the start and extensive support during the race.
course_highlights: Varied courses with ITRA points from 1 to 5
Courses ranging from mini to ultra-extreme marathons
Beautiful natural landscapes of Fruška Gora, with challenging climbs and descents
additional: Organized transport from Novi Sad to the race start on April 25, 2026, from 6 a.m. Registration for individual sport categories and groups is open until April 15, 2026. The race includes courses with different ITRA point values, from 1 to 5, and distances suited to runners of all levels. The event features multiple race categories, online registration, organized transport from Novi Sad, and a variety of courses for runners of all levels.

name: Šumadija Trejl Staza Snage (Gledićke Planine)
description: Šumadija Trail Strength Course is a challenging race through the unspoiled nature of the Gledić Mountains, with two courses that test runners’ strength and endurance. The longer course, Prkos, is 17.5 km long with 1,000 meters of elevation gain, while the shorter course, Zamah, is 8 km long with 450 meters of elevation gain. The race combines steep climbs and technical descents, offering a unique challenge and an opportunity to enjoy Šumadija hospitality. The start and finish are at Adžine Livade, and runners receive a generous race pack and a surprise lunch.

name: 4. Jablanik Trail
description: Jablanik Trail is a UTMB Index race held in Valjevo, Serbia. The race is 34 kilometers long with a total elevation gain of 1,837 meters, offering runners challenging and attractive terrain. The course provides a unique opportunity to experience the natural beauty of western Serbia through its mountainous landscapes. The race brings together experienced runners and trail-running enthusiasts, creating a competitive and friendly atmosphere.

name: Mozdulj Csepel!
description: A Mozdulj, Csepel! egy ingyenes családi futóverseny, amelyet a Csepeli Önkormányzat szervez az Aktívan Csepelért Programsorozat keretében. A verseny a meseszép csepeli dunaparton, a Kolonics György Szabadidőközpontból indul, és négy távon kínál lehetőséget a mozgásra: 3,5 km, 7 km, 400 m gyerekfutam, valamint egy speciális futam fogyatékkal élők számára. A verseny célja a közösségi élmény és a mozgás örömének megosztása minden korosztály számára, környezettudatos szemlélettel, pohármentes frissítéssel. A rajtszám viselése kötelező a 3,5 km-es és 7 km-es távokon, és chipes időmérés biztosítja a pontos eredményeket.

name: Galbicska Péter Emlékfutás Tata 7 / 14
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: A VI. Galbicska Péter Emlékfutás 2026. április 25-én kerül megrendezésre Tata, a Tópart sétányon. A verseny két távon, 7 km (1 tókör) és 14 km (2 tókör) teljesítésével várja a futókat, akik korosztályonként és nemenként is nevezhetnek. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, a tóparti környezetben zajlik, és a résztvevők számára egyaránt kihívást és élményt nyújt. A rajt 10:00-kor kezdődik, a nevezés pedig április 23-án 18:00 óráig lehetséges.

name: BACKYARD ULTRA ESZTERGOM
description: A Backyard Ultra Esztergom 2026 egy különleges ultrafutó verseny, amely az utolsó emberig tart. A versenyzők egy 6706 méteres kört teljesítenek óránként, és csak azok maradnak versenyben, akik a következő rajtig beérnek. A verseny a Hungarian Backyard League része, korosztályos bajnokságként kerül megrendezésre, ahol 11 korosztályban díjazzák a legjobb női és férfi futókat. A verseny helyszíne a Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya Esztergomban, és a résztvevők között akár 160 kilométeres távot is teljesítők is elismerést kapnak.

name: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom
description: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom is Romania’s first charitable mountain biking race, now in its 14th edition. The event takes place in the town of Urlați, Prahova County, on April 25, 2026, among the area’s hills, vineyards, and wineries. Participants can choose from several routes suited to their ability, ranging from 4 km for children to 50 km for experienced cyclists. The race promotes cycling as a healthy lifestyle and supports important social causes.
course_highlights: 50 km route for experienced cyclists
30 km route for amateur cyclists and juniors
18 km route recommended for less experienced cyclists
additional: The children’s races (4 and 8 km) start at 09:00, the 18, 30, and 50 km routes at 10:35, and the Family Ride at 10:45. Race packs can be collected in Bucharest and at the venue during specified time slots. Family Ride participants do not receive a race kit and may go directly to the start. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00, and the cutoff time is 16:30. The event also includes activities for families and children, supports social and educational causes, and promotes wine culture and local tourism.
