description: Alergăraș în Făgăraș is a sporting event that brings together runners of all ages and performance levels to explore the natural and cultural beauty of the Făgăraș area. The courses offer a complete experience, with steep climbs, descents through spectacular scenery, and well-organized hydration points, while the start and finish take place near the historic fortress. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, supported by an enthusiastic community and dedicated volunteers. The event promotes grassroots sport and respect for nature, offering a memorable day of running and socializing amid mountain scenery.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and descents through spectacular scenery
Start and finish in the area of Făgăraș Fortress
Well-stocked hydration points and excellent course marking
additional: Premium finisher medal, cash prizes for podium finishers, ITRA points and a UTMB Index for the Maratonu’ de pe Ardeal and Belvedere races, a voucher for a hot meal after the race, medical support with an ambulance, a massage tent, food and hydration points along the course and at the finish, and the option to purchase a technical running shirt. Multiple race categories, including marathon, trail, cross-country, and relays; the event includes cultural and tourist activities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the natural beauty of the Făgăraș area.

name: Maratonul Codrului
description: Maratonul Codrului, ediția a V-a, este un eveniment organizat de Club Sportiv Pro Racers și Federația Română de Ciclism, ce va avea loc pe 25 aprilie 2026 la Lacul Oţeloaia, Satu Mare. Este o competiție dedicată atât amatorilor, cât și profesioniștilor, cu probe MTB și Trail Run pe trasee spectaculoase prin pădure, cu provocări pentru toate nivelurile. Evenimentul oferă trasee noi și mai provocatoare la probele MTB, precum și probe hobby cu trasee scurte pentru a încuraja participarea. De asemenea, există o cursă specială pentru copii, iar participanții beneficiază de pachet de start, cronometrare, puncte de hidratare, asistență medicală, pasta party și medalii de finisher.

name: Forest Race Marghita
description: Forest Race Marghita este o competiție de alergare pe traseu accidentat, cu dificultate medie, desfășurată în pădurea foioasă din apropierea orașului Marghita. Evenimentul este organizat de Clubul Sportiv Run For Freedom împreună cu Clubul Sportiv XTERRA Sport Bihor și oferă patru trasee diferite, adaptate pentru diverse niveluri de alergători. Startul și finish-ul sunt în Parcul de Aventură Freedom, iar traseele sunt bine marcate pe drumuri forestiere. Concursul promovează un stil de viață sănătos și respectul pentru mediul înconjurător.

name: Антеа рън
description: Antea Run is a unique race combining 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles in the scenic area around Sozopol. It’s not just a marathon, but a challenge for anyone who wants to push their limits and enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The event attracts running and adventure enthusiasts looking for something more than an ordinary race.
course_highlights: 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles
Scenic area around Sozopol
A combination of running and overcoming challenges

name: Асеновградски Баири
description: Asenovgrad Hills is a race and festival that combines sport and outdoor fun in Asenovgrad and the Rhodope Mountains. The event includes mountain running and cycling, held on two separate days, allowing participants and guests to enjoy the region’s nature and attractions. Organized by the Asenovgrad Hills Association, the race offers various distances for runners and cyclists, suitable for different ages and fitness levels. Participation requires good physical fitness and appropriate equipment. The event is aimed at people who love sport and nature.

name: Национален шампионат 10 000м - писта
description: The National 10,000m Track Championships in Hisarya is a prestigious competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The championship brings together Bulgaria’s best athletes to compete over the classic 10-kilometer distance on the track. The event is part of the federation’s 2026 sports calendar and highlights the traditions and development of athletics in Bulgaria.

name: Студентско бягане "UNIRUN"
description: UNIRUN is a student running event in Sofia that connects sport with a social cause, supporting youth sports and cage-free shelters. The event takes place in West Park and offers four distances of varying difficulty, from 1 km to a half marathon of 21 km. Participants join a community that inspires movement, healthy living, and social engagement, while enjoying music, games, and prizes. The run is accompanied by festival activities and opportunities for personal development and social connections.

name: Takovski grm
description: Takovski Grm is a 13.5 km road race taking place on April 26, 2026, starting in Takovo and finishing in Gornji Milanovac. The race runs through Takovo’s historic natural surroundings along a newly opened route, with plenty of uphill and downhill sections, offering a challenge and the enjoyment of natural beauty. The organizers invite runners to join them for a shared running experience, race results, and a gathering at the finish. All participants who complete the race receive a finisher’s medal, while the top runners are awarded cash prizes and trophies.

name: IX. Miklósi Futónap
description: A IX. Miklósi Futónap egy családbarát futóverseny Szigetszentmiklóson, amely 2026. április 26-án kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget a futásra, 500 métertől egészen a félmaratonig (21 km). A rendezvény a Városi Sportcsarnok elől indul, és a Szebeni út, Petőfi út, Gerincút útvonalon halad, majd visszatér a sportcsarnokhoz. A futók számára öltöző, ruhatár és WC is biztosított a helyszínen. A verseny célja a sport és közösség népszerűsítése minden korosztály számára.

name: III. Strázsa-hegyi Trail Futóverseny 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
description: A III. Strázsa-hegyi Toyota Kovács Trail Futóverseny 2026. április 26-án kerül megrendezésre Monoron, a Strázsahegyi dűlőben. A versenyen 500 méteres családi futam, valamint 2, 5, 10 kilométeres és félmaratoni távok közül választhatnak a résztvevők. A futók változatos terepen, természetközeli környezetben teljesíthetik a távokat, melyek között megtalálhatók a 10 km-es és félmaratoni útvonalak is. A rendezvény célja a sport és a természet szeretetének népszerűsítése, családbarát hangulatban.

name: STRÁZSA-HEGYI TRAIL
description: A III. Strázsa-hegyi Toyota Kovács Trail Futóverseny 2026. április 26-án kerül megrendezésre Monoron, a Szent Orbán téren. Ez a harmadik alkalom, hogy a versenyzők a festői Strázsa-hegy környékén, változatos terepen mérhetik össze erejüket. A futóverseny családias hangulatban, természetközeli környezetben kínál kihívást minden résztvevőnek. A rendezvény a sport és a közösségi élmény jegyében zajlik, várva a futás szerelmeseit.

name: ÍROTTKŐ HILLCLIMB
description: Az Írottkő Hillclimb egy változatos és emlékezetes hegyi futóverseny, amely 2026. április 26-án kerül megrendezésre Kőszeg Rőtfalva környékén. A verseny új rajthelyszínnel, Bozsokról indul, és több távon kínál kihívást a futóknak, a 7 km-es bevezető terepfutástól a 102 km-es Alpokalja Ultráig. A pályák változatos terepen, szép panorámákkal és frissítőpontokkal várják a résztvevőket, akiknek kitartásra és jó fizikai felkészültségre lesz szükségük. A verseny családbarát programokat is kínál, így a legkisebbek is élvezhetik a természetvédelmi és interaktív kiállításokat.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: A Futapest Terepfutás Bér verseny egy izgalmas terepfutó esemény, amely Bér, Virágospuszta festői környezetében kerül megrendezésre. A futók változatos, természetközeli útvonalakon mérhetik össze erejüket, élvezve a természet szépségeit és a kihívást jelentő terepet. A verseny a Futapest Klub szervezésében zajlik, amely hosszú évek óta támogatja a terepfutás és crossfutás sportágát Magyarországon. Minden futót szeretettel várnak, akik szeretnének egy jó hangulatú, közösségi futóeseményen részt venni.

name: Bucharest International Half Marathon
description: Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță brings runners to the streets of Bucharest in a race initiated by Olympic marathon champion Constantina Diță. The event includes a half marathon and a 10 km race, open to both competitive and amateur runners. The course is flat and fast, suitable for those aiming for a good result or wanting to enjoy a run in the capital.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course
Running on the streets of Bucharest
Half marathon and 10 km races
additional: Individual, family, and friends registrations are mentioned, as well as the Team 3 Challenge.

name: URME PE PLAY
description: Urme pe Play este o competiție de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în comuna Rășinari, la poalele munților Cindrel și Lotru. Traseele sunt marcate și includ poteci naturale, drumuri forestiere și asfalt, oferind o experiență submontană autentică. Evenimentul este deschis atât adulților, cât și copiilor, cu curse dedicate pentru fiecare categorie de vârstă. Participanții se pot bucura de peisaje pitorești și de atmosfera prietenoasă a comunității locale în cadrul unui eveniment ce combină sportul cu cultura și tradiția locală.

name: Pancharevo Trail Marathon
description: Pancharevo Trail Marathon is the largest spring mountain running event in Bulgaria, held near Pancharevo Lake. The race offers three distances: a 42 km marathon with 1,700 m of elevation gain, a 21 km half marathon with 700 m of elevation gain, and a 10 km route suitable for beginners, as well as a 15 km mountain hike. The routes pass through the scenic Lozen Mountain, with views of Vitosha, Stara Planina, Rila, and Iskar Reservoir. The event is organized by the Begach sports club and attracts more participants every year.

name: XL kmrun - Банкя
description: XL Bankya is a new race on the XLkmrun calendar, held in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain near Sofia. The course is shaped like a figure eight, starting on the northern outskirts of the town of Bankya and heading toward Ostrа Chuka Peak. Participants can choose between two distances: 6.4 km with 217 m of elevation gain, or 12.8 km. The course offers challenges for mountain-running enthusiasts. The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes a variety of courses and distances in Sofia and other cities.

name: Бистрица Вертикал Рън
description: Bistritsa Vertical Run is a scenic and challenging race that starts in the village of Bistritsa, which is accessible by public transport. The route crosses varied terrain with gradual but demanding climbs, reaching the Kikish area, which offers panoramic views of Sofia. The course continues to Kamen Del Hut, where participants can refuel with food and drinks. This race is an excellent strength and endurance workout, suitable for preparing for long distances and running in mountain conditions.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване за мъже и жени и юноши и девойки под 20 г.
description: The National Mountain Running Uphill Championship for men, women, and under-20 boys and girls takes place on April 26, 2026, in Bistritsa village, Sofia. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and offers a challenging uphill mountain race for different age groups. The organizers provide official registration and support for competitors, with communication handled directly with them. The event is a tradition and attracts athletes seeking a competitive experience on mountain terrain.

name: Etyekrun
organizer: RUNaway Sportszervező Kft. és Etyek Trend
description: Az EtyekRUN egy különleges futóverseny Etyek lankáin, ahol a borvidék hangulata, dűlők, szőlősorok és a tavaszi táj kíséri a résztvevőket minden lépésükön. A verseny a Garmin WTF sorozat része, amely a mozgás örömét és a teljesítmények sokszínűségét ünnepli, legyen szó akár rövidebb aszfaltos, akár hosszabb terepfutó távokról. A rendezvény családbarát, és a közösségben a fenntarthatóság, a következetesség és az öröm áll a középpontban. A versenyzők egyedülálló élményben részesülnek a természet és a borvidék szépségei között.

name: XI. Ezerjó Félmaraton 5 / 10 / 21
description: Az XI. Ezerjó Félmaraton 2026. május 1-jén kerül megrendezésre Móron, a Szent István téren. A verseny három távon kínál kihívást: 5 km, 10 km és félmaraton (21 km). A futók gyönyörű szőlőhegyek között, változatos terepen, emelkedőkkel és panorámás kilátással teljesíthetik a távokat. A rendezvény családbarát, gyerekfutamokkal is várja a kisebbeket, és a célban frissítőkkel, befutóéremmel díjazza a résztvevőket. A verseny egyedi hangulatát a helyi borvidék és a közösségi élmény adja.

name: FUT AZ ÜLLŐ
description: A "Fut az Üllő" egy hagyományos városi futóverseny, amely Üllő városközpontjában kerül megrendezésre. A verseny célja a sport és a közösségi élet népszerűsítése, amely minden korosztály számára nyitott. A rendezvényen korlátozott számban helyszíni nevezés is lehetséges a verseny napján reggel 7 órától. A verseny szervezője Üllő Város Önkormányzata, amely a helyi közösség támogatásával biztosítja a rendezvény sikerét.

name: II. Mohácsi Gőcze Trail
description: A II. Mohácsi Gőcze Trail egy szabadidős futóverseny, amely 2026. május 2-án kerül megrendezésre Mohácson, a Szőlőhegyi rendezvénytéren. A verseny a Mohácsi-dombság ösvényein zajlik, és különböző távokat kínál minden korosztálynak, az 500 méteres gyerekfutamtól a 22 km-es távig. A rendezvény családbarát, egészségügyi biztosítással és díjazással várja a résztvevőket, akik chipes időméréssel mérhetik idejüket. A versenyzők közös bemelegítésen vehetnek részt a rajt előtt, és a részvétel saját felelősségre történik.

name: MOHÁCSI GÖCZE TRAIL (2.)
description: A Mohácsi Gőcze Trail egy terepfutó verseny, amely a Mohácsi Szőlőhegyi rendezvénytéren kerül megrendezésre. A versenyen minden célba érkező fém befutóérmet kap, és a távonként, nemenként az első három helyezett egyedi díjazásban részesül, beleértve a gyermek futamokat is. A rendezvény a futás és a közösség erejét hirdeti, és a résztvevők számára kiváló minőséget és alacsony árakat biztosít. A verseny 21 km-es távon zajlik, amely Ötpróba pontokat is ér. A szervezők a futás testi és lelki egészségre gyakorolt pozitív hatásait hangsúlyozzák.

name: Sălciua Trail Run
description: Sălciua Trail Run 2026 este o competiție de alergare în natură desfășurată în comuna Sălciua, situată între Munții Trascău și Muntele Mare, oferind o priveliște spectaculoasă. Evenimentul reunește pasionați de alergare, natură, cultură și distracție, fiind o oportunitate de a evada din cotidian și de a te bucura de frumusețea naturii în compania celor dragi. Competiția include patru curse: Cursa Zmeilor (28 km), Crosul Liliecilor (15 km), Family and Young Run (5 km) și Cursa Spiridușilor (400-800 m), deschise tuturor participanților care respectă condițiile de vârstă și înscriere. Organizatorii asigură o experiență completă, cu kituri de concurs, festivitate de premiere și ateliere tematice pentru toate vârstele.

name: Chindia City Race
description: Chindia City Race este o alergare tradițională organizată în inima Cetății Târgoviștei, chiar lângă emblematicul Turn al Chindiei. Evenimentul are loc pe 2 mai 2026, în Piața Tricolorului, și adună participanți de toate vârstele, într-o atmosferă de sărbătoare și competiție prietenoasă. Startul este programat la ora 10:00, iar cursa celebrează spiritul și istoria orașului, invitând alergătorii să-și testeze viteza și rezistența pe un traseu urban plin de energie și tradiție.

name: MaricaRUN
description: MaricaRUN 2026 is a unique sporting event featuring 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 1 km children’s run, held in the beautiful Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. The race combines sport, excitement, and a charitable cause, with 40% of entry fees donated to charity. The course is flat, suitable for everyone, and passes through the most beautiful parts of the park, with views of the Maritsa River. Participants will enjoy a well-organized route with refreshment stations and a festive atmosphere featuring prizes and sports demonstrations.

name: Коджа Кая
description: Kodzha Kaya is Bulgaria’s first fully autonomous ultramarathon, held in the village of Bilka, in the Kodzha Kaya Peak area. The race offers various distances with substantial elevation gain and no aid stations, making it a true test of endurance and skill. Participants are challenged to finish before sunset while enjoying breathtaking views and natural beauty. This event is for lovers of adventure and mountain running, and leaves memories to last a lifetime.

name: МарицаРън 2026
description: Maritsa Run 2026 is a professionally organized race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event offers three distances: 1 km for children up to 14 years old, 5 km for a fun sporting challenge, and 10 km for a greater personal achievement. The course passes through the most beautiful parts of Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad, including its paths, the river, the relaxation area, and art installations. Participants can enjoy a great atmosphere with music, spectators, and support along the route, as well as prizes and recognition, with a prize fund of over €1,500.

name: 24. Öntúlszárnyalás maraton
description: A 24. Öntúlszárnyalás maraton 2026. május 3-án kerül megrendezésre a pécsi Malomvölgyi-tónál. Ez a Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team által szervezett futóverseny családias hangulatú, körpályás, amely lehetőséget ad a maratoni és félmaratoni távok teljesítésére. A pálya erdei döngölt és zúzott köves, 30 méter szintkülönbséggel, így változatos terepen mérhetik össze erejüket a résztvevők. A versenyen chip-es időmérés biztosítja a pontos eredményeket, és a frissítőállomások bőséges ellátást nyújtanak.

name: Farkasmályi Dűlő és Pince futás
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: A Farkasmályi Dűlő és Pince futás egy hangulatos terepfutó verseny Gyöngyös Farkasmály dűlősorán, amely a szőlőskertek és borospincék között zajlik. A verseny több távon kínál kihívást, köztük egy rövidebb, kevésbé szintes 3 km-es kört és egy hosszabb, 8,5 km-es emelkedőkkel tarkított kört. A futók élvezhetik a természet közelségét, a pincelátogatásokat és a változatos terepet, amely alkalmas kezdőknek és haladóknak egyaránt. A rendezvényt a GYÖTRI Klub szervezi, amely több évtizedes tapasztalattal bír a sportesemények lebonyolításában.

name: MÁSODSZOR IS CÉLBA ÉRÜNK!
description: A Koraszülöttfutás 2026 egy jótékonysági futóesemény, amely Zalaegerszegről indul és Keszthelyig tart, összesen 66 km-es távon. A futás során a résztvevők gyönyörű zalai tájakon haladnak át, tíz váltóponttal, és a teljes távot chip-es időméréssel követik nyomon. A rendezvény kiemelten támogatja a koraszülötteket, akiknek betétfutása is része az eseménynek. A célban a csapatok együtt érkezhetnek, hogy megosszák az élményt és a sikert. A rajt és a tészta party helyszíne a Zala Zone Járműipari Tesztpálya, a futás pedig május 3-án vasárnap kerül megrendezésre.

name: Mechi Chal Trail Chepelare
description: Mechi Chal Trail is an exciting mountain race taking place on May 3, 2026, in Chepelare, at Olympic Square. The courses follow mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The race offers three distances with different elevation gains, challenging participants with true mountain terrain. Every finisher receives a medal, and the winners receive cash and merchandise prizes.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване и спускане мъже и жени, под 20 г., под 18г., под 16г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship—uphill and downhill—for men and women, as well as under-20, under-18 and under-16 boys and girls, takes place in Chepelare. The competition offers challenging mountain terrain that tests participants’ endurance and skills. It is an important event in the Bulgarian athletics calendar, attracting both young and experienced runners. The organizers provide professional event management and support for all participants.

name: Sri Chinmoy Run and Become Marathon
10 дневно състезание „Шри Чинмой“
description: The 10-day Sri Chinmoy race in Sofia is the first certified multi-day race in Bulgaria and takes place in St. Peter and Paul Park. The race is run on a flat, certified 785-meter asphalt loop, with each participant competing to cover the greatest possible distance over 10 days. The event is organized with attention to detail, including official lap counting and strict rules for fairness and safety. Participants can enjoy the atmosphere of the race village and the support of the organizers and fellow runners.

name: 2. E.ON Business Run
description: Az E.ON Business Run egy különleges futóesemény, amelyet a Nemzeti Atlétikai Központban rendeznek meg Budapesten. A verseny célja, hogy összehozza a vállalati világ szereplőit és minden érdeklődőt egy közös mozgásélményre, ahol egyéni és csapatszellem is érvényesül. A futók három táv közül választhatnak: 5 km egyéni futás, 3 fős váltó (3x2,7 km) és egy 2 km-es stadiontúra gyaloglás. Az eseményt zene, buli és streetfood kíséri, így a futás után is felejthetetlen élmény várja a résztvevőket.

name: E.ON BUSINESS RUN
description: Az E.ON Business Run egy különleges futóesemény, amelyet 2026. május 6-án rendeznek meg a Nemzeti Atlétikai Központban, Budapesten. A verseny nemcsak a vállalati világ szereplőit, hanem minden érdeklődőt vár, hogy együtt mozogjanak, küzdjenek és bulizzanak. A rendezvény három távon zajlik: egyéni 5 km, 3 fős váltó (3x2,7 km) és egy 2 km-es stadiontúra gyaloglás. A célban egyedi befutóéremmel várják a résztvevőket, és a hangulatról zene, streetfood és esti buli gondoskodik.

name: РЕКОРД НА ХАЙДУШКАТА ПЪТЕКА 2026
location: Sinite Kamani Nature Park, Sliven, Bulgaria
description: The Haidushka Path Record 2026 is an annual race held in Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven. Participants race up the iconic trail from its starting point to the large fountain by Karandila Hotel. The route offers different variations of varying difficulty. The race is for prestige, with no categories or prize money; results are officially recorded and published for every participant who completes the climb in under 1 hour. It is a unique challenge for mountain-running and nature enthusiasts.

name: ЮНАШКИ ИГРИ 2026
location: Сините камъни Nature Park, Sliven, Bulgaria
description: Yunashki Games 2026 take place in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven on May 6, in honor of the birthday of Hadji Dimitar and St. George’s Day—the Day of Courage. The event celebrates the traditions and spirit of the haiduks, featuring games and competitions in which they tested their strength when choosing a voivode. The course and atmosphere are connected to the region’s historical heritage and the natural beauty of Sinite Kamani. The event is organized by the Old Elm Foundation, which works to preserve Sliven’s cultural heritage and nature.

name: Iron Ultra Trail
description: Iron Ultra Trail is a challenging trail race held in Valjevo, known for its demanding routes and beautiful landscapes of Western Serbia. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts and adventurers, offering a unique experience through forest and mountain terrain. The organizers, West Serbia Trails, guarantee a great atmosphere and good organization for all participants.

name: Columbia Sunset Trail
description: A Columbia Sunset Trail egy izgalmas, naplemente idején megrendezett terepfutó verseny a Naszály-hegy környékén. A versenyzők egyedi fa befutóérmet kapnak, és a távok első három női és férfi helyezettje külön díjazásban részesül. A rendezvény bőséges frissítőpontokkal, öltözőkkel és csomagmegőrzéssel várja a futókat, akiknek fejlámpa és ivózsák használata ajánlott. A verseny hangulata és a természet közelsége garantáltan felejthetetlen élményt nyújt.

name: COLUMBIA SUNSET TRAIL
description: A Columbia Sunset Trail egy izgalmas, naplementében zajló terepfutó verseny Naszály festői környezetében. A versenyzők egyedi fa befutóéremmel gazdagodnak minden távon, és a legjobbak külön érem díjazásban részesülnek. A rendezvény bőséges frissítőpontokkal, öltözőkkel és csomagmegőrzéssel várja a futókat, akiknek fejlámpa és ivózsák használata ajánlott a biztonságos teljesítéshez. A verseny hangulata és a természet közelsége garantáltan felejthetetlen élményt nyújt.

name: Crosul de noapte
description: Crosul de Noapte - Delonghi is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants two distances: 4 km and 10 km. The event takes place on May 8, 2026, and is suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a nighttime sporting experience in the city. It is an excellent opportunity to run in an urban setting with a friendly and competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: 4 km and 10 km distances
Night run in Cluj-Napoca
Urban course accessible to all levels
additional: The event includes well-marked courses, online registration, and a safe environment for participants.

name: Fox Trail Čardak 2026
description: Fox Trail Čardak is a race through the unique landscape of the Deliblato Sands, giving participants the opportunity to choose from three distances: a recreational 5 km, a challenging 12 km, and a 21 km trail half marathon. The event takes place on May 9, 2026, in Čardak and is intended for all nature and running enthusiasts, whether beginners or experienced runners. The course is carefully designed to offer an authentic running experience in nature, with challenges and the natural beauty of the sands.

name: FARKASMÁLYI DŰLŐ- ÉS PINCEFUTÁS
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: A Farkasmályi Dűlő- és Pincefutás egy különleges futóverseny Gyöngyös Farkasmályi pincesorán, amely 2026. május 2-án kerül megrendezésre. A verseny során a résztvevők gyönyörű szőlődűlők és borospincék között haladnak, változatos terepen, kisebb emelkedőkkel. A futamok között megtalálható egy rövidebb, kevésbé szintes kör, valamint egy hosszabb, nagyobb szintkülönbséggel rendelkező kör is, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő távot. A rendezvényt a GYÖTRI Klub szervezi, amely a térség egyik meghatározó sportegyesülete.

name: SzalamandRUN futónap 3 / 5 / 11 / 21 / 42
description: A SzalamandRUN futónap egy változatos távokat kínáló futóverseny Solymáron, amely 3, 5, 11, 21 és 42 km-es távokon várja a futókat. A rendezvény ideális mind a kezdők, mind a tapasztalt futók számára, akik szeretnék kipróbálni magukat különböző távokon. A verseny a természetközeli környezetben zajlik, amely élvezetes futást biztosít a résztvevőknek. A rendezvény szervezői professzionális időméréssel és kényelmes regisztrációs lehetőségekkel várják a nevezőket.

name: Előzd meg a Fogaskerekűt!
description: Az Előzd meg a Fogaskerekűt! egy hagyományos XII. kerületi sportrendezvény, amely 2026-ban is várja a futókat, kerékpárosokat és váltóban induló csapatokat. A verseny célja, hogy a résztvevők előbb érjenek célba, mint a Fogaskerekű vasút, miközben egy kb. 4 km-es, 325 méter szintemelkedésű emelkedőt teljesítenek a Budai-hegységben. A verseny kihívást jelent minden edzettségi szinten lévő sportolónak, és családok, kollégák számára is remek közösségi program. A rendezvényt a Hegyvidéki Szabadidősport Nonprofit Kft. és a Városmajori Tanuszoda szervezi.

name: Krones Charity Run
location: Debrecen, Déli Ipari Park, Hermann utca 1
description: A Krones Charity Run egy jótékonysági futóverseny, amelyet 2026. május 9-én rendeznek meg Debrecenben, a Déli Ipari Park területén. A verseny célja a sport és a testmozgás népszerűsítése mellett a helyszín bemutatása, valamint a Leukémiás Gyermekekért Alapítvány támogatása, amelynek a nevezési díjak teljes összege és a Krones Hungary által megduplázott adományok kerülnek átadásra. A résztvevők több táv közül választhatnak, és minden célba érkező egyedi befutóérmet kap. A versenyen MIZUNO eseménypóló és teljes BioTechUSA frissítés biztosított, a rendezvény végén pedig az Athletes Garden várja a futókat.

name: CSALÁDI FUTÓNAP
description: Az EDURACE Családi Terepfutó Nap egy családbarát, szabadidős terepfutó esemény, amelyet az EDUSPORT Sportegyesület szervez. A verseny Gödöllőn, az Erzsébet Parkban kerül megrendezésre, és minden korosztály számára kínál futamokat, a gyerekfutamoktól a félmaratonig. A rendezvény célja az egészséges életmód és a közösségi élmény népszerűsítése, szakértői támogatással és változatos programokkal. A résztvevők befutócsomagot, érmet és frissítést kapnak, a napot pedig egy színes Color Run zárja.

name: EDURACE
description: Az EDURACE Családi Terepfutó Nap egy változatos terepfutó verseny, amely 2026-ban Gödöllőn, az Erzsébet parkban kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több távot kínál, az 500 méteres gyerekfutamoktól a félmaratonig, így minden korosztály és futótapasztalat számára ideális. A természetközeli útvonalak és a közösségi élmény mellett egyedi befutóérem és jó hangulat várja a résztvevőket. A rendezvény célja, hogy a családokat és a sportkedvelőket egyaránt megszólítsa, és az egészséges, aktív életmódot népszerűsítse.

name: FUT A VÁROS
description: A Szombathelyi Futóverseny, a Fut a város, 2026. május 9-én kerül megrendezésre a város szívében, a Fő téren. A verseny több távon kínál futási lehetőséget, így minden korosztály és futó megtalálhatja a számára megfelelőt: 400 méteres gyermekfutam, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km egyéni, valamint 4×2,5 km-es váltó. A rendezvény célja a sport és az egészséges életmód népszerűsítése, egyedi befutóérmekkel és chipes időméréssel várják a résztvevőket. A verseny hangulata családias, a város történelmi helyszínein vezető pályákon zajlik, biztosított frissítőpontokkal és orvosi felügyelettel.

name: ÚJPESTI FÉLMARATON
organizer: Budapest Főváros IV. ker. Újpest Önkormányzata
description: Az Újpesti Félmaraton egy népszerű futóverseny, amely 2026. május 9-én kerül megrendezésre a Halassy Olivér Sportközpontban, Budapest IV. kerületében. A verseny lehetőséget kínál egyéni és váltó nevezésre, negyedmaraton és félmaraton távokon. A rendezvény célja a sport és a közösségi élmény népszerűsítése Újpesten, barátságos és családias hangulatban. A nevezés során pólóméretet is lehet választani, és a szervezők gondoskodnak a gördülékeny lebonyolításról.

name: SCHRÖDINGER DELUXE ULTRA
description: A Schrödinger Deluxe Ultra 2026 egy terepfutó verseny a Piliscsaba környékén, amely 2026. május 9-én kerül megrendezésre. A verseny rajtja a Csemetekertnél lesz reggel 8 órakor. A futók változatos terepen haladnak, érintve több neves helyszínt és természeti pontot a Pilis hegységben. A verseny egyedülálló élményt kínál a természet és a kihívás kedvelőinek.

name: Zuglói-Patakparti Futás
distance_verbose: 100 miles, 120 km, 5 km, 2.2 km, 1 km, 0.3 km

name: Bucharest International Half Marathon

description: The Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță is an international half marathon held on some of Bucharest’s most beautiful and fastest streets, offering both professional athletes and amateur runners the opportunity to achieve a competitive personal best. The event also includes 10 km races, races for people with mobility impairments, and a 3.5 km fun run for all ages. The race kit includes a bib with chip timing and a finisher’s medal, while the official T-shirt is optional. The organizer is the Constantina Diță Sports Club Association, and the event is supported by major partners such as Decathlon.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on Bucharest’s main streets
World Athletics Label-certified half marathon course
Dedicated routes for the half marathon, 10 km, people with disabilities, and the fun run
additional: The race kit must be collected in person at the Expo, upon presentation of an ID document. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for EUR 15. Participation for wheelchair users is free. The time limit is 3 hours for the half marathon and 1.5 hours for the 10 km race. Some streets will be closed during the event, so using public transport is recommended, especially the metro to Aviatorilor station. The course offers options for running and walking, with the opportunity to take part in record attempts; the event also includes other races, such as the 10 km and relay races.

name: Subcarpați Trail Run
location: Baza Sportivă „Stejarul”, Cocorăștii Mislii, Prahova, Romania
distance_verbose: 50 mile, Maraton, Maraton, 23 km, Semimaraton, 5 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Categoria de vârstă 14–17 ani beneficiază de taxă redusă: 150 lei pe toată perioada înscrierilor

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Fun Race – 125 lei / persoană, indiferent de vârstă

description: Subcarpați Trail Run is a mountain running competition organized for trail running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience in the heart of Goruna Forest, in the Prahova Subcarpathians. The varied courses, from the Fun Race to the Ultramarathon, test runners’ endurance and perseverance in spectacular natural surroundings. The event brings together amateurs and professionals in a friendly, motivating atmosphere, with the start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii. It is an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the area and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Courses through Goruna Forest, with scenery of wooded hills
Distances and difficulty levels vary, from the 4 km Fun Race to the 75 km Ultramarathon with 2,800 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday from 16:30 to 21:30 and on Saturday morning, depending on the race. The Ultramarathon starts at 06:00, the Marathon at 10:00, and the Half Marathon and Cross Country Race also at 10:00. The Fun Race starts after 11:45. Cash and product prizes are awarded to winners, including bonuses for course records. Varied courses, start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base, on-site registration available, official photographers on the course.

name: Thermal Trail Race 2026
description: Thermal Trail Race este o competiție de trail running ce se desfășoară în Betfia / Băile 1 Mai, pe potecile pitorești ale pădurii din zonă. Evenimentul oferă două probe, una de 14 km și una de 7 km, potrivite pentru diferite categorii de vârstă și niveluri de experiență. Traseele sunt bine marcate și oferă o experiență sportivă în natură, cu premii pentru cei mai buni concurenți. Participanții beneficiază de cronometrare electronică și tricou oficial al evenimentului.

name: Trascău Trail Run ~ 2026
description: Trascău Trail Run este o cursă montană ce oferă trei probe: maraton, semimaraton și cros, desfășurate în peisaje pitorești din zona Rimetea, Alba. Traseele trec prin locuri spectaculoase precum Piatra Secuiului, Cetatea Colțești, Cheile Plaiului și Peștera Huda lui Papară, oferind o experiență de alergare montană cu diferențe semnificative de nivel și priveliști impresionante. Evenimentul este organizat de Asociația Green & Wild și pune accent pe aventura în natură și patrimoniul local. Participanții beneficiază de puncte de hidratare și alimentare, medalii și premii, iar înscrierile sunt limitate și se fac online.

name: TRAILRUN IN TARA NASAUDULUI
description: Trail Run în Țara Năsăudului este un eveniment de alergare în natură destinat tuturor categoriilor de vârstă și nivelurilor de experiență, desfășurat în jurul Casuțelor din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud. Evenimentul oferă trei curse diferite: un traseu de 2 km pentru copii și familii, un traseu intermediar de 5 km cu urcări scurte și poteci de pădure, și un traseu de 10 km dedicat alergătorilor care caută o provocare autentică de trail running. Participanții se bucură de o atmosferă de susținere, socializare și fair-play, cu puncte de hidratare pe trasee și un Starter Kit inclus pentru cursele de 5 km și 10 km.

name: Международен турнир за юноши и девойки под 18 г. „Младост”
description: The “Youth” International Tournament for boys and girls under 18 is held at the City Stadium in Ruse. This event has a rich tradition and brings together young athletes from various countries to compete in a range of track and field disciplines. The tournament supports the development of youth sport and gives talented athletes under 18 the opportunity to compete. The organizers emphasize the importance of registered performances for participation in certain disciplines, such as the girls’ long jump.

name: Трън Ултра Рън
description: Tran Ultra Run is an ultramarathon mountain-running event held in the picturesque Kraishte region, based in the village of Turokovtsi, Tran Municipality. The event offers four courses of varying distances and elevation gains, passing through the Rui, Ezimir, and Greben mountains, with numerous panoramic views and varied terrain ranging from soft trails to rocky sections. Organized by the Tran Tourist Association with the support of Tran Municipality, the event is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge and beautiful scenery.

name: Alpinist TRI
description: The Climbing Triathlon “New Life for the Alpinist Hut” is a unique competition that replaces classic swimming with a vertical challenge. It takes place around the Alpinist Hut and the village of Basarbovo, Ruse, and includes three disciplines: MTB cycling, running, and a final Via Ferrata climb. The competition can be entered individually or as a two-person relay, and all funds raised go toward restoring the hut. It’s an opportunity to test your strength against nature and support a worthy cause in one of the most beautiful areas of the Polomie region.

name: Amusnet Charity Run 2026
description: Amusnet Charity Run 2026 is a trail run with a cause, held in the area of the village of Zheleznitsa, near Sofia. The course is just over 5 km long and offers varied terrain, including a beautiful forest trail, a challenging climb, and a final descent. The event is open to everyone, whether you want to run or walk. The main goal is to take part and support the National Paralympic Federation. For every kilometer covered, Amusnet donates €5 to support the cause, which helps Bulgarian athletes with disabilities.

name: Tran Ultra Run
description: Tran Ultra Run is a mountain race held in the picturesque Kraishte region, based in the village of Turakovtsi, Tran Municipality. The race offers four courses of varying distances and elevation gains, passing through the Ruy, Ezimirska, and Greben mountains, with numerous peaks and panoramic views. The courses are loop routes with varied terrain, including soft trails, rocky sections, steep slopes, and forest areas. Organized by the Tran Tourist Society with the support of Tran Municipality, the race provides course marking, aid stations, and medical assistance for participants.

name: Urbani polumaraton
description: The Urbana Desetka Sports Association invites you to take part in the Urbana Half Marathon in Smederevo on May 10, 2026. The event features the second year of the 21 km half marathon and the third year of the 10 km Danube Ten, races that run along the banks of the Danube, through the city center, past the Obrenović Villa and through the Jugovo neighborhood. Runners will enjoy a combination of flat terrain and rolling vineyards, with the start at Republic Square in front of the courthouse. Each participant receives a chip-timed bib, a unique T-shirt and a medal, as well as refreshments during and after the race.

name: First Challenge Run
description: First Challenge Run is a charity race taking place on May 10, 2026, at Ada Ciganlija in Belgrade. Runners will complete a 7.7 km loop around the lake, enjoying nature and a sporting challenge. The race is an opportunity to gather, socialize, and support a charitable cause, and is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners.

name: Ugrin run
description: Ugrin Run is a race taking place in Ugrinovci on May 10, 2026, starting at 10:00. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, on a highly accessible, safe, and clearly marked course, with two water and fruit aid stations. In addition to the main races, fun children’s races are organized for different age groups. These are free with parental consent. Participants receive a unique medal at the finish, and merchandise prizes and trophies are provided for the top finishers.

name: Kozomor 2026
description: The Kozomor Hiking and Running Association and the PSS Hiking Trekking Commission invite competitors to the second round of the Serbian Trekking and Trail League, which will take place on May 10, 2026, in Kosjerić. This race brings together enthusiasts of mountain trekking and trail running, offering a challenging and scenic route through nature. Participants can expect a well-organized event supported by experienced hiking and running enthusiasts.

name: Garmin WTF BRZSNY
organizer: RUNaway Rekreációs Kft. és RUNaway Sportszervező Kft.
description: A Garmin WTF BRZSNY egy egyedülálló terepfutó verseny Szokolya és Királyrét környékén, amely 2026. május 10-én kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több távon kínál kihívást, 8 km-től egészen a terepmaraton 42 km-ig, változatos szintemelkedéssel és gyönyörű erdei környezetben. A verseny különlegessége, hogy aszfaltos és terepfutók együtt rajtolnak, így mindenki a saját terepén teljesítheti a távot. A nevezési díj tartalmazza a rajtszámot, időmérést, frissítőpontokat, csomagmegőrzést, öltözőt és mentőszolgálatot, valamint a célban kürtőskalácsot és választható érmeket. A verseny a fenntarthatóságot és a közösségi élményt helyezi előtérbe, ahol minden teljesítmény értékes.

name: IX. Runbogárd Futóverseny és családi futónap
description: A IX. Runbogárd Futóverseny és családi futónap 2026. május 10-én kerül megrendezésre Sárbogárdon, a Városi Sportcsarnoknál. A versenyen 1 km-es Mosolyfutam, valamint 5 km, 10 km és 20 km távok várják a futókat, akik egyszerre, tömegrajttal indulnak. A rendezvény célja a sport szeretetének népszerűsítése és egy közösségi esemény létrehozása, ahol minden korosztály megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő távot. A rajtszámokat előzetesen kell átvenni, helyszíni nevezés nincs, az időmérés chippel történik, amely a rajtszám hátuljára van ragasztva.

name: Fertőrákos félmaraton 6 / 16 / 21
description: A Fertőrákosi Félmaraton egy különleges panorámafutás a Fertő-tó felett, amely a Kőfejtő - Barlangszínháznál indul és ér véget. A pálya változatos, enyhén hullámzó, és a környék legszebb részeit érinti, a hosszabb távon Balfig is el lehet jutni, miközben a festői Fertő-tó és nádasok látványa kíséri a futókat. Ez a verseny nemcsak kihívás, hanem egy élményfutás, ahol minden kilométer új látványt és inspirációt nyújt. A rendezvény zöld versenyként is működik, kiemelve a környezetvédelem fontosságát.

name: EU-S FUTÁS 2026
organizer: Európai Bizottság Magyarországi Képviselete, Európai Parlament Magyarországi Kapcsolattartó Iroda, Nagy Sportágválasztó, BBU Nonprofit Kft.
description: Az EU félmaraton egy ingyenes, regisztrációhoz kötött futóverseny, amelyet 2026. május 10-én rendeznek meg Budapesten, a Szabadság téren. A versenyen 21,1 kilométeres távot lehet teljesíteni egyéniben vagy 2-3 fős váltóban, amely a budapesti Európa-napi fesztivál része. A futók egy háromkörös útvonalon haladnak, amely Budapest ikonikus helyszínein vezet keresztül, és minden célba érkező egyedi emlékérmet kap. A rendezvényt az Európai Bizottság Magyarországi Képviselete és az Európai Parlament Magyarországi Kapcsolattartó Irodája szervezi, szakmai partnere a Nagy Sportágválasztó, BBU Nonprofit Kft.

name: FUSSUK LE! FÉLMARATON FESZTIVÁL
description: A Fussuk le! Félmaraton Fesztivál egy háromnapos futóesemény Csongrádon, amely 2026. május 8-10. között kerül megrendezésre. A fesztiválon koncert, közösségi programok és versenyek várják a résztvevőket, ahol a félmaraton és negyedmaraton távok mellett gyerekfutamok is szerepelnek. A pálya lapos, aszfaltos, így ideális minden futó számára, aki egy jó hangulatú, támogató közösségben szeretne versenyezni. A rendezvény célja, hogy felejthetetlen élményt nyújtson, ahol mosolyogva lehet futni és célba érni.

name: UBM RED RUN FUTÓVERSENY
description: Az UBM RedRun futóverseny 2026. május 10-én kerül megrendezésre Pilisvörösvár szívében, a Kacsa-tó környékén. Az esemény ötödik jubileumi alkalommal várja a futókat, akik 300 métertől 21 km-ig választhatnak távokat, egyéni vagy csapatos formában. A verseny új pályákkal, kibővített távokkal és egyedi futamokkal kínál élményt minden korosztálynak, különös hangsúlyt fektetve a családokra és amatőr sportolókra. A rendezvény célja a közös sportélmény megteremtése biztonságos és barátságos környezetben, Pilisvörösvár legszebb részein.

name: VW Mureș Half Marathon
description: VW Mureș Half Marathon 2026 te invită să alergi în inima Transilvaniei, prin centrul orașului Târgu Mureș, pe 10 mai 2026. Evenimentul oferă trasee variate de 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, ștafetă 4x5 km și cursă pentru copii, toate cu startul și sosirea în zona centrală, ideală pentru susținerea de către familie și prieteni. Participanții vor descoperi punctele turistice reprezentative ale orașului într-o atmosferă vibrantă de primăvară, bucurându-se de premii, medalii și energie bună la fiecare pas. Organizatorul este Asociația Mureș Runners, care promovează un stil de viață sănătos și comunitatea prin sport.

name: Elenovo Trail Run 2026
location: село Еленово, местност "Кара дере", община Нова Загора, област Сливен, Bulgaria
organizer: Народно читалище "Светлина-1908" и Община Нова Загора
price_range: до 12 април - по-ниска цена, след това - по-висока
description: Elenovo Trail Run is a new trail-running event in Nova Zagora Municipality, Sliven Province. The race takes place in the scenic Kara Dere area near the village of Elenovo, with varied courses suitable for runners of different levels. The event is part of the regional folklore festival and offers a unique opportunity to combine sport and nature with local traditions. The organizers provide GPX files for the courses to help participants prepare.
course_highlights: Courses of 4 km, 10/11 km, and 20/21 km on mountainous terrain
The Kara Dere area, with scenic views and natural beauty
Held as part of a folklore festival with a rich cultural program
additional: GPX files for the courses are available to download and use for preparation. The event takes place in an area with the Kara Dere reservoir. The organizer is the Nova Zagora Tourist Information Center, with coordinator Daniel Yordanov. The courses are available as downloadable GPX files; the event includes various routes and cultural activities in the Kara Dere area.

name: Sunrise Ultra
description: Sunrise Ultra is a challenging race along the rugged cliffs of Bulgaria’s northern coast, offering three distances: 42 km, 17 km, and 7 km. The race passes through iconic natural and cultural landmarks in the municipalities of Kavarna and Shabla, combining endurance with the beauty of the seascape. Participants receive a special T-shirt and medal inspired by the sunrise and the vastness of the sea, symbolizing the spirit of the event. It is a unique experience for nature and running enthusiasts seeking adventure and inspiration.

name: Wings for Life
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair participants, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. Instead of a traditional finish line, competitors run until they are caught by the virtual “Catcher Car,” which starts 30 minutes after the beginning and gradually increases its speed. The event raises funds for spinal cord research, with 100% of entry fees and donations going to this cause. Participants can gather at the popular “The Sun” spot in Borisova Gradina and take part through the Wings for Life World Run mobile app.

name: XL kmrun - Плана
description: XL Plana is a trail race and part of the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place near the village of Plana, close to Sofia, in the Plana Mountain. Participants can choose from three distances—5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km—which cross open terrain with varied conditions, including wet and sunny sections. The race is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural setting.

name: Луковит рън
description: The Lukovit Run road race is an annual 8.8-kilometer event that starts in the center of Lukovit and finishes at Prohodna Cave. The race attracts runners of different ages and abilities, with past winners including Ismail Senandzhi and Marinela Nинеva. The event is part of the Municipality of Lukovit’s sports calendar and offers a mass start over 800 meters for younger participants. The course is scenic and challenging, combining urban and natural surroundings.

name: Мемориал „Веселин Даскалов”
description: The Veselin Daskalov Memorial is a traditional athletics competition held in Lukovit, Bulgaria. The jubilee 20th edition took place at the city stadium, with more than 200 athletes from across the country competing in various distances from 100 m to 1500 m. The competition attracts both children and national-level athletes, providing opportunities for young talents and established competitors to showcase their skills. The organizers hold an official awards ceremony attended by local representatives and sports figures.

name: Маратон "Розова долина" - Rose Valley Marathon
description: The Rose Valley Marathon in Kazanlak is a sporting event for running enthusiasts of all levels. Its main goal is to encourage physical activity and introduce participants to the beauty of Bulgaria’s Rose Valley. The race offers three distances: a classic marathon of 42 km, a half marathon of 21 km, and a 10 km race. The start and finish are in Rosarium Park, in front of the Museum of Roses in Kazanlak. The course passes through the city, along cycling paths, and on secondary roads, with around 100 meters of elevation gain. The event takes place on May 10, 2026, at 09:00 and offers refreshment stations every 5 km, as well as awards in various categories.

name: СТЕНАТА RUN 2026
description: STENATA RUN 2026 is a race held near the Shumen Reservoir in the city of Shumen. The event offers various distances and formats, including individual and relay runs lasting from 1 to 6 hours. The course is suitable for runners with different levels of fitness and goals, combining natural beauty with challenges. The organizers, Shumen Early Runners, invite you to take part in this dynamic and friendly race.

name: Nebeski visovi – 4. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: The Nebeski Visovi race in Zlatibor is the fourth round of the National Mountain Running Series, organized by the Tornik Mountaineering Club from Čajetina. Participants can choose between two loop courses: a longer 21 km red course with 1,400 meters of elevation gain for seniors, and a shorter 10 km blue course with 500 meters of elevation gain for juniors. The routes pass through Zlatibor’s unspoiled nature and over the peaks of Ljujaš, Orlić, Jelova Gora, Bandera-Tornik, and Liska, offering scenic, wild landscapes. The race brings together competitors from across Serbia and abroad. Scoring in the National Series follows the rules of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, a member of the World Mountain Running Association.

name: SALOMON ULTRA TRAIL HUNGARY
location: Lázár cár tér, Szentendre, Pest County, Hungary
distance_verbose: 111 km, 50 miles, 50 km, Maraton, 30 km, Félmaraton
description: The Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary is Hungary’s most prestigious trail-running race, consisting of six separate distances and attracting around 1,500 trail runners in total. The race takes place across varied terrain, including dense, dark forests, with challenging climbs. The longest distance is 111 km, with 4,200 m of elevation gain, 9 aid stations, 2 drop bags, and a 20-hour cutoff. The race is held in Szentendre, with the start and finish at Lázár cár Square. A detailed map and an information center are available to runners and their accompanying supporters to help ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: 111 km distance with 4,200 m of elevation gain
9 aid stations and 2 drop bags on the longest distance
Dense, dark forests and varied terrain
additional: The race has a maximum capacity of 1,600 participants, with 300 places available on the longest distance. The race’s Google map shows the aid stations, start and finish locations, and race headquarters. There are staffed crossings along the course where supporters are not allowed to cheer. The Dömös and Pap-rét aid stations cannot be reached by car and require a 30-minute walk. Registration for the race opens on November 2, 2025, with various entry options and activities associated with the event.

name: COLOPLAST TATA TÓ FUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: A COLOPLAST Tatai Tófutás egy hagyományos tömegsport futóverseny, amelyet a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervez. A verseny a tatai tó körül zajlik, változatos terepen, amely ideális mind a hobbi, mind a versenyszerű futók számára. A rendezvény a futás és a természetjárás iránt érdeklődőknek egyaránt remek lehetőséget kínál a sportolásra és a közösségi élményre. A verseny 2026. május 16-án kerül megrendezésre az Új kajakháznál, Tatán.

name: CSEPELI CSIRIPELŐ
location: Kolonics György Szabadidőközpont, Csepel, Budapest, Hungary

name: BORVIDÉK FÉLMARATON
distance_verbose: 23 km, Félmaraton, 14 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km

name: EcoRun Moieciu ~ 2026
description: EcoRun Moieciu este un eveniment de alergare montană de top în România, ce se desfășoară în Moieciu de Sus. Concursul include curse de Maraton, Semi și Cros, precum și o cursă pentru copii, EcoKids. Traseele sunt compuse în proporție de 90% din drumuri forestiere și poteci montane, oferind o experiență autentică de alergare în natură, cu peisaje spectaculoase și o comunitate pasionată. Evenimentul promovează practici sustenabile și se desfășoară anual în luna mai, reunind alergători de toate nivelurile.

name: Turnu Roșu Challenge
description: Turnu Roșu Challenge este o competiție de alergare submontană ce se desfășoară pe poteci marcate în Turnu Roșu și pe dealurile de la poalele Munților Făgăraș, oferind un cadru natural spectaculos și o provocare pentru toate nivelurile de pregătire. Evenimentul include trei curse: semimaraton de 21 km, cros de 11 km și hiking de 7 km, fiecare adaptat pentru diferite tipuri de participanți, de la experimentați la cei care doresc o experiență relaxantă. Organizatorii pun accent pe siguranță, recuperare și socializare, oferind facilități precum sesiuni de stretching, masaj post-alergare, camping și activități pentru copii. Este o ocazie excelentă de a te bucura de natură, sport și comunitate în județul Sibiu.

name: Crosul Cetăților Suceava
description: Crosul Cetăților Suceava este o cursă de alergare populară ce se desfășoară în orașul Suceava, oferind participanților o experiență sportivă în aer liber, cu trasee adaptate pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de pregătire. Evenimentul include curse pentru copii, o cursă populară și o cursă de cros, promovând mișcarea și spiritul comunitar. Participanții pot alerga pe trasee ce trec prin zone istorice și pitorești, înconjurate de cetăți și peisaje locale. Organizatorii asigură un kit de participare și premii pentru concurenți, încurajând implicarea și performanța sportivă.

name: Run to the Hills
description: Run To The Hills este o cursă de alergare montană organizată în Crasna, Jud. Sălaj, care are loc pe 16 mai 2026. Evenimentul invită pasionații de alergare să exploreze dealurile pitorești din zonă, oferind o experiență sportivă în natură. Este o oportunitate excelentă pentru alergători de toate nivelurile să se bucure de peisaje frumoase și de o atmosferă prietenoasă.

name: SEMIMARATON FETESTI
description: Semimaratonul Fetești este un eveniment sportiv anual care aduce împreună alergători din regiune pentru curse de diferite distanțe, inclusiv semimaraton și crosuri. Organizatorii, Asociația Sportivă Feteștiul Aleargă, promovează sportul și sănătatea în comunitate, oferind o experiență plăcută și competitivă. Evenimentul are o tradiție în zonă și se desfășoară pe trasee variate, potrivite pentru toate nivelurile de alergători.

name: Business Run Varna
description: IHB Business Run Varna is the largest team-building race in Bulgaria, held at the BulYard shipyard and Bulport Logistics in Varna. It is a relay race for teams of four, with each participant running 4 km before passing the baton to the next runner. The event combines sporting spirit and corporate teamwork, bringing together many companies and their employees in a dynamic, friendly format. In addition to the main race, there is also a Kids Run for children aged 4 to 12, supported by certified coaches.

name: Somborski polumaraton
description: The Sombor Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Sombor, with a new course passing through beautiful parts of the city. The event brings together a large number of runners from Serbia and abroad, promoting a healthy lifestyle and recreational running. The organizers strive to make the race well organized and enjoyable for all participants, with particular attention to the atmosphere and socializing. The race is part of the rich program of activities of the Somaraton Athletics and Recreation Club, which has nurtured Sombor’s long-standing running tradition.

name: 29. Kékes Csúcsfutás
description: A 29. Kékes Csúcsfutás Magyarország egyik legszebb és legikonikusabb futóversenye, amely 11,6 km-es távon 671 méter szintemelkedéssel vezet fel Magyarország legmagasabb pontjára, a Kékes csúcsára. A verseny a Mátra lenyűgöző természeti környezetében zajlik, ahol több ezer futóval együtt élheted át ezt az egyedülálló kihívást. A célban egyedi érem várja a résztvevőket, hogy örökre emlékezetes maradjon ez a nap. A verseny nemcsak fizikai erőpróba, hanem egy igazi kaland és élmény is, amelyre mindenkit szeretettel várnak.

name: KÉKES CSÚCSFUTÁS TRAIL
description: A Kékes Csúcsfutás egy ikonikus és kihívásokkal teli futóverseny Magyarország legmagasabb pontjára, Kékestetőre. A verseny 11,6 km hosszú, 671 méter szintemelkedéssel, gyönyörű természeti környezetben, a Mátra panorámájával. A résztvevők egyedülálló élményben részesülnek, miközben a hegyre vezető folyamatosan emelkedő út próbára teszi kitartásukat. A versenyen egyedi éremmel jutalmazzák a célba érkezőket, és lehetőség van jótékonykodásra is a nevezés során.

name: KÉKES CSÚCSFUTÁS
description: A Kékes Csúcsfutás Magyarország egyik legszebb és legikonikusabb futóversenye, amely 11,6 km távon 671 méter szintemelkedéssel vezet fel Magyarország legmagasabb pontjára, a Kékestetőre. A verseny a Mátra festői tájain, csodálatos természeti környezetben zajlik, és igazi kihívást jelent minden futónak, aki szeretné kipróbálni kitartását és erőnlétét. A rendezvényen több száz településről érkeznek futók, és egyedi éremmel várják a célba érkezőket, hogy emlékezetessé tegyék ezt a napot. A verseny nem csupán egy futóesemény, hanem egy belső utazás is, ahol a természet és a teljesítés öröme találkozik.

name: Timotion
price_range: Participație între 75 RON și 1.200 RON, în funcție de cursă

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Target minim donații Participă Target 1.200 RON

description: Timotion is the largest charitable sporting event in western Romania, bringing together thousands of participants, volunteers, and supporters each year to run, cycle, and do good for the community. The event offers a variety of races for all ages and fitness levels, from cycling and a half marathon to children’s races and fun races on wheels. By taking part, runners and cyclists support community projects and help foster solidarity and hope in the region. Timotion is a movement of hearts united for good, with a tradition spanning more than 10 years and a continuously growing community.
course_highlights: The timed 15 km SMW cycling race is for experienced participants
A 21 km half marathon and 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km fun runs for various age categories
Special races for children and fun races on wheels, also accessible to people with reduced mobility
additional: Races are timed and have specific time limits; children’s races require a legal guardian to accompany participants; the cycling race is for non-electric bicycles; accessible races are available for people with reduced mobility; races take place on Bd. Ion C. Brătianu; races start in waves between 08:00 and 17:30. Multiple races on May 10, including cycling, a half marathon, and recreational races; fundraising component; volunteering opportunities

name: Accenture Heroes Challenge
description: Accenture Heroes Challenge este o competiție intensă de teste de forță, viteză, agilitate și skill-uri, desfășurată în Parcul Sportiv Universitar Iuliu Hațieganu din Cluj-Napoca. Ediția a doua, programată pentru 17 mai 2026, provoacă participanții să își depășească limitele printr-un traseu cu obstacole. Evenimentul oferă două distanțe, 6 km și 12 km, pentru a satisface atât alergătorii experimentați, cât și pe cei care doresc o provocare mai scurtă.

name: Crosul Sport4All
description: Crosul Sport 4 all este un eveniment sportiv de alergare organizat anual la Lugoj, destinat tuturor vârstelor și nivelurilor de pregătire. Evenimentul include curse ne-cronometrate pentru copii și cursa populară de 2 km, precum și curse cronometrate de 4 km și 6 km pentru participanții mai mari. Traseele sunt bucle în jurul Universității Europene Drăgan și pe străzile centrale ale orașului, oferind o experiență urbană plăcută. Participanții primesc medalii de participare, iar cursele sunt organizate cu categorii de vârstă pentru cursele cronometrate. Evenimentul este susținut de Primăria Lugoj și Universitatea Europeană Drăgan, cu 400 de locuri gratuite oferite de sponsorul Mondial S.A.

name: Prima Evadare
description: Prima Evadare este cel mai mare maraton de ciclism cross country din România, desfășurat anual pe un traseu clasic între București și Snagov. Concursul oferă o experiență prietenoasă și accesibilă, cu o distanță de aproximativ 55 km prin păduri și drumuri de țară, fără diferențe mari de nivel. Evenimentul adună pasionați de ciclism din toată țara, oferind o atmosferă energică și prietenoasă, ideală pentru deschiderea sezonului de maratoane MTB.

name: ApriltsiRun
location: Априлци, Община Априлци, гр. Априлци, кв. "Острец, ул. "Цанко Дюстабанов" 12
organizer: Община Априлци, Сдружение „Троян в бъдещето“, НД „Традиция“ – 34-ти Пехотен Троянски полк
description: ApriltsiRun is a mountain race inspired by the heroic events of the April Uprising of 1876. The race follows historic trails around Maragidik Peak and Botev Peak, along which the insurgents traveled 150 years ago. The courses offer varying levels of difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain-running enthusiasts. The event combines sport, nature, and history, marking the anniversary of the uprising with panoramic routes and a charitable cause.

name: Маратон Варна
description: Varna Marathon is one of the most exciting sporting events in the maritime capital, combining challenge, emotion, and unforgettable moments. The course runs along Varna’s beautiful coastline, offering fresh air and picturesque views of the sea. The event attracts both local and international athletes, creating an atmosphere of sporting passion and support. Varna Marathon is a test of endurance and strength of spirit that inspires participants to achieve new personal goals.

name: Маратон на приятелството Плевен
description: The Friendship Marathon Pleven is a traditional event taking place on May 17, 2026, in the center of Pleven. The race includes a marathon, half marathon, 10.55 km race, relay, and the Vidas Run Kids children’s marathon. The certified courses pass through scenic parts of the city and Kaylaka Park. The event combines sport with a charitable cause supporting medical students. Organizers provide aid stations, medical services, and a full program for race day.

name: Спици и Бодли 2026
description: Spokes and Thorns 2026 is a cross-country mountain biking and duathlon event held at the foot of the Stara Planina Mountains near Kazanlak. The event offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both beginner and advanced cyclists. In addition to the sporting competition, participants and guests can enjoy a festival featuring live music, outdoor cinema, yoga, horseback riding, and other activities. The event combines sport, entertainment, and community in an unforgettable atmosphere.

name: 1. Tibužde Trail
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in Tibužde, Vranje. Runners can choose between two course distances, 27 km and 7 km, offering challenging terrain and beautiful scenery. The event starts in the morning and lasts all day, giving participants a unique trail-running experience.
course_highlights: A 27 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
A shorter 7 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
Natural terrain around Tibužde
additional: The event runs from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Terrain: mountainous; registration open; several categories, including a children’s race; shared lunch after the race.

name: Dragutin Tomašević
description: The Dragutin Tomašević Memorial Athletics Race is held in the village of Bistrica near Petrovac na Mlavi in memory of the first Serbian Olympian. This anniversary 21st race brings together runners of all ages and categories, offering opportunities to compete in men’s and women’s divisions as well as by age group. Participants receive chip-timed race bibs and “Joma” Dry Fit shirts, while the organizer provides transportation and a formal dinner. The race is known for its tradition and support from the local community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all runners.

name: Ivanjica Trail
description: Ivanjica Trail is a unique trail race in Serbia, bringing together runners of different fitness levels across several courses of varying lengths and difficulty. The races take place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Ivanjica and Golija, with viewpoints, meadows, forests, and streams, offering an unforgettable running experience in nature. Special highlights include the Golija PREMIUM race, which starts at the summit of Golija, and the ULTRA 66K, a two-day stage race connecting three mountains and offering a challenge for experienced runners. The organizers provide race packs, refreshments, lunch, transport, and accommodation for participants, creating a friendly and supportive atmosphere.

name: ONERUN 2026
description: One Run is an international race taking place for the eighth consecutive year, simultaneously across multiple countries and continents. The event is known for being entered into the Guinness World Records twice as the world’s largest half marathon with a synchronized start. The race is open to everyone, with four distances available, and promotes health, accessibility, and togetherness through sport and outdoor activities. This year, we’re running in Veliko Gradište, Serbia, on May 23, aiming to become part of a new attempt at a Guinness World Record for the first time in Serbia.

name: Hegyre Megyek - Badacsonyi Futófesztivál 500m / 4 km / 8 km / 11 km / 21 km
LÉLEKFUTÁS ÉS PIKNIK
description: A Lélekfutás és Piknik egy szeretetteljes közösségi esemény Magyarpolányban, amely a test és lélek mozgásáról, feltöltődéséről szól. A futóversenyen kicsik és nagyok egyaránt részt vesznek, majd a napot finom ételek és meditatív programok, például labirintusjárás és gongos hangfürdő teszik teljessé. Ez az esemény nem csupán sport, hanem egy élő, lélegző közösségi ünnep, amely a természet ölelésében zajlik. A rendezvényt a Habitus Alapítvány szervezi, és a Polányi Pünkösdi rendezvénysorozat részeként kerül megrendezésre.

name: SALGÓTARJÁN – LOSONC MARATONVÁLTÓ
description: A Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón - štafety egy váltóverseny Salgótarján és Lučenec között, amely 42,2 km-es távot ölel fel hat szakaszban, 4-6 fős csapatok számára. A verseny útvonala festői településeken halad át, és a futók a teljes távot váltva teljesítik. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, frissítőpontokkal és a célban gulyással várja a résztvevőket, miközben kulturális programok is színesítik a napot. A verseny 2025. augusztus 23-án kerül megrendezésre, és a nevezés augusztus 20-ig online lehetséges, később csak helyszíni regisztrációval, ha van még hely.

name: SALOMON TWIN PEAKS TRAIL
description: A Salomon Twin Peaks Trail egy 22 kilométeres terepfutó verseny, amely a Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary része. A pálya a Dömös és Szentfa-Kápolna környékén vezet, és magában foglalja a híres "két tüskét", amelyek különleges kihívást jelentenek a futóknak. Ez a verseny egyedülálló célbaérés élményt kínál Magyarországon, amelyet csak az UTH adhat meg. A verseny ideális azoknak, akik szeretnének belekóstolni az Ultra-Trail Hungary hangulatába és terepfutó kihívásaiba.

name: SALOMON VISEGRAD TRAIL
description: A Salomon Visegrád Trail egy 30 kilométeres terepfutó verseny, amely az egykori visegrádi római őrtoronytól indul és a szentendrei belvárosig vezet. A futók a Visegrádi-hegység legszebb és legnehezebben járható részein haladnak át, változatos és kihívást jelentő terepen. A verseny a természet szerelmeseinek és a terepfutás rajongóinak egyaránt felejthetetlen élményt nyújt. A rendezvény hagyományosan magas színvonalú, és a résztvevők számára jól szervezett támogatást biztosítanak a pálya mentén.

name: Dac Warrior
description: Dac Warrior 2026 is a unique obstacle race in Romania, taking place on May 23 in Tohani, Gura Vadului, Prahova. The courses are challenging, with significant elevation gain and a variety of obstacles designed to test participants’ physical endurance and willpower. The event offers an experience of initiation and reconnection with the spirit of the Dacian ancestors, combining athletic effort with tradition and authentic nature. Participants can choose from several events, ranging from 6 km to 21 km, each with its own challenges and obstacles. The atmosphere is one of camaraderie and competition, and after the race participants are invited to discover the local culture and enjoy its traditions and rituals.
course_highlights: Ultimate Run: 21 km with 1,060 m of elevation gain and over 30 obstacles
Legend Run: 11.6 km with 690 m of elevation gain and 25 obstacles
Brave Run: 7.35 km with 348 m of elevation gain and 20 obstacles
additional: Registration validation and race-kit pickup take place on Friday, May 22, 2026, between 16:00 and 20:00 at Domeniul Satul Dacilor. The courses feature a variety of obstacles, including low fences, log jumps, rings, sandbags, a log pyramid, ropes, parallel bars, monkey bars, a muddy trench, a wall traverse, and a surprise obstacle. There are age- and gender-based prize categories, with cash prizes for the top finishers. The race is recommended for experienced participants, especially the Ultimate Run, which is a challenging OCR. The event offers different distance categories and courses and is open to both amateur and advanced runners.

name: JIDVEI WINELAND TRAILS
description: Jidvei Weinland Trails este un eveniment sportiv unic desfășurat pe domeniul Castelului Bethlen-Haller, în inima Transilvaniei. Concursul combină alergarea și ciclismul pe trasee pitorești ce străbat podgoria Jidvei, oferind participanților peisaje spectaculoase și o experiență autentică în mijlocul naturii. Evenimentul include curse pentru toate nivelurile de pregătire, de la copii la adulți, și oferă activități recreative și oenogastronomice pentru întreaga familie. Este o sărbătoare a sportului, culturii și tradiției locale, cu o atmosferă prietenoasă și sigură pentru toți participanții.

name: Obciniada Night Run
organizer: Obciniada / Asociația Ținuturi Durabile / Asociația Club Sportiv Bucovina între Obcini
description: Obciniada Night Run este o cursă de alergare nocturnă în inima Bucovinei, ce oferă trasee spectaculoase și o atmosferă de festival sub stele. Evenimentul este organizat pentru a promova mișcarea în aer liber și un stil de viață sănătos, implicând comunitatea locală și susținând educația copiilor defavorizați. Participanții pot alege între mai multe distanțe, de la semimaraton la curse pentru copii, bucurându-se de o experiență autentică în natură, cu puncte de hidratare, masă caldă și premii. Festivalul combină sportul cu o atmosferă prietenoasă și responsabilă față de mediu.

name: Tour de Tur
description: Tour de Tur este o competiție anuală de mountain bike și trail running care se desfășoară în zona Lacului Mujdeni, Comuna Orașu Nou, județul Satu Mare. Evenimentul oferă trasee variate pentru toate nivelurile, de la curse de maraton MTB la alergare trail, fiind dedicat atât sportivilor profesioniști, cât și amatorilor pasionați de natură și aventură. Ediția a XX-a din 2026 promite o experiență sportivă completă, cu trasee bine marcate și diferențe de nivel semnificative, într-un cadru natural pitoresc. Organizatorii invită toți participanții să se înscrie online și să se bucure de atmosfera competitivă și prietenoasă a evenimentului.

name: Маратон Каланджа
description: Kalandzha Marathon is a celebratory event marking 10 years since its inception in 2026. It takes place in the village of Sinemorets and offers mountain running distances of 42, 21, 13 km, and 3 km for children, as well as mountain biking distances of 42 and 21 km. The courses pass through the scenic routes of Strandzha Nature Park, bringing together sport, nature, and community. The event includes race packs, an awards ceremony, and a party, creating a festive atmosphere for participants.

name: Trail trka Tibuzde 2026
location: село Тибужде, 5 км од града Врање
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in the village of Tibužde, near Vranje. The race offers two different distances, 27 km and 7 km, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy challenging terrain and the beauty of nature. The race starts at 7 a.m., and the event runs until 5 p.m., creating a great atmosphere for all running and nature enthusiasts.

name: SALOMON SZENTENDRE TRAIL
description: A Salomon Szentendre Trail egy 54 kilométeres terepfutó verseny, amely Szentendrén és környékén zajlik, 1800 méter szintemelkedéssel. A futók átkelnek tizenkétszer az Apátkúti-patakon, és a verseny során gyönyörű tájakon, köztük Visegrádon és a Kálvárián haladnak át. A cél Szentendre főterén és a Duna korzón van, ahol a turisták tapsolnak a befutóknak. Ez a verseny egyedülálló élményt nyújt a természet és a városi környezet találkozásával.

name: SALOMON SZENTLÁSZLÓ TRAIL
description: A Salomon Szentlászló Trail egy izgalmas terepfutó verseny Szentendrén, amely a Visegrádi-hegység legmeredekebb emelkedőit kínálja. A verseny hajnalban indul, és a résztvevők a gomolygó párás Sikárosi-réten futnak át, miközben a kakukk köszönti őket. A célba érkezés előtt még a turisták tapsolása is várja a futókat a sétálóutcákon és a Főtéren. Ez a kihívás a természet szerelmeseinek és a terepfutás rajongóinak egyaránt felejthetetlen élményt nyújt.

name: Semimaraton Casa Bună Sânpetru
description: Semimaraton Casa Bună Sânpetru este un eveniment sportiv organizat cu scop caritabil, care oferă participanților oportunitatea de a alerga pe trasee variate și pitorești în zona Sânpetru, Brașov. Evenimentul este recunoscut pentru atmosfera prietenoasă, organizarea impecabilă și sprijinul acordat familiilor defavorizate prin Casa Bună Sânpetru. Traseele includ opțiuni de dificultate diferită, potrivite atât pentru începători, cât și pentru alergători experimentați, oferind peisaje frumoase și provocări sportive. Participarea la acest semimaraton înseamnă nu doar o experiență sportivă, ci și o contribuție la o cauză nobilă.

name: Semimaraton Galați
description: Semimaraton Galați este un eveniment filantropic-sportiv care combină performanța sportivă cu responsabilitatea socială, reunind alergători profesioniști și amatori, familii și voluntari. De peste 12 ediții, evenimentul susține cauze comunitare locale prin taxele de participare și donații, finanțând proiecte dedicate educației, sănătății și incluziunii sociale. Traseele variate și atmosfera comunitară fac din Semimaraton Galați o experiență unică, care aduce sportul mai aproape de comunitate și promovează solidaritatea. Ediția din 2026 continuă această tradiție, oferind curse pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de pregătire.

name: Crosul Copiilor
description: Crosul Copiilor 2026 este o competiție dedicată copiilor cu vârste între 0 și 14 ani, desfășurată în Parcul Central din Baia Mare. Evenimentul oferă curse adaptate pe categorii de vârstă, de la Baby Run pentru cei sub 4 ani, până la curse cronometrate competitive pentru grupele mai mari. Este o cursă plină de energie, bucurie și susținere din partea părinților, unde fiecare copil este încurajat să participe și să se bucure de alergare. Organizatorii limitează numărul participanților pentru a asigura o experiență plăcută și sigură pentru toți.

name: BUFF – GOMU 72H WC
organizer: Central European Ultra Series /CEUS/, Balatonfüredi Atlétikai Club, Balatonfüredi Sport Club, Magyar Ultrafutó Liga /KAHU/, Bakonyország&Balcsipart Egyesület, Balatonfüred Város Önkormányzata
description: A BUFF-CEUS 72H World Cup egy nemzetközi ultrafutó verseny, amely Balatonfüreden, a Füred Kemping és Üdülőfalu területén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több időtartamú futamra oszlik, köztük 72, 48, 24, 12 és 6 órás futamokra, amelyek a Central European Ultra Series részeként zajlanak. A pálya egy 898 méteres kör, minimális, 1 méteres szintemelkedéssel, így ideális a hosszútávú futók számára. A versenyzők egyéni és csapat kategóriákban is indulhatnak, és minden résztvevő emlékérmet kap. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és a versenyközpontban központi frissítőasztal áll rendelkezésre.

name: Ultrabug
description: Ultrabug is a fully supported, 3-day ultramarathon held on scenic mountain trails in Romania’s Carpathian Mountains, in the Fundu Moldovei area. The main route covers 100 km across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and villages with a rich culture, and is suitable for all fitness levels, including first-time ultra participants. The event also includes shorter alternative races, such as Marathon XFun, Ultra XFun and Fun Run, offering participants a range of options. After the race, participants are invited to an awards ceremony and a traditional party with local food. Ultrabug is internationally recognised, awards iTRA points and has been voted among the 50 best ultramarathons abroad.
course_highlights: A 100 km route across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and traditional villages
Spectacular scenery with green pastures and the authentic sounds of bells and running water
Alternative routes of 42 km + 8 km, 50 km + 8 km, and an 8 km race open to all ages
additional: A jacket/hoodie is included only for registrations made by 1 May 2026. The event awards finishers 3 iTRA points. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a party with traditional food, including BBQ with polenta, cheese and homemade bread. The race is open to runners, hikers and walkers, with a minimum age of 18 for the 100 km race; the 8 km race is open to all ages. The event includes accommodation at Casa Ileana in Fundu Moldovei, awards iTRA points and attracts international participants.

name: Mokra Gora Trail
description: Mokra Gora Trail is a new regional hiking trail that runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia.
