The trail is part of the Via Dinarica network and offers a unique opportunity for adventure tourism and exploration of the Balkans’ unspoiled nature. It was developed with the support of the Institute for Territorial Economic Development and the Regional Cooperation Council, with the aim of promoting cross-border tourism and preserving the region’s natural beauty. The trail is known for its Via Ferrata attractions, which offer exciting experiences for hikers and nature lovers.
course_highlights: The trail runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting three countries: Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia
It is part of the Via Dinarica network, known for its unspoiled nature and mountain landscapes
Via Ferrata sections offer adventure opportunities for hikers
additional: The trail is part of the Via Dinarica cross-border project and was developed to promote sustainable tourism and improve infrastructure. No race price or registration details are listed, indicating that the focus is on the hiking trail rather than a competition. The contact organization is the Regional Cooperation Council, headquartered in Sarajevo. The project is linked to the development of regional hiking trails, including Via Ferrata, GPS mapping and the installation of signage, with the aim of promoting sustainable tourism and cooperation in the region.

name: Tour de Fruška
distance_verbose: 59 km, 39 km, Polumaraton, 15 km, 7 km, 2 km, 1 km
description: Tour de Fruška is one of the region’s most attractive sporting events, held in the beautiful surroundings of Fruška Gora, in Vrdnik. The event brings together sport, nature, and tourism, offering participants a unique experience of cycling through unspoiled nature and beautiful landscapes. It gathers cycling and active holiday enthusiasts, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the tourism potential of Vojvodina.

name: Ozren i Devica 2026
description: The Devica–Ozren hiking trip, organized by PSK Pobeda, takes participants on a climb up Mount Devica, one of the most beautiful and northernmost mountains in the Balkans. The route passes through lush vegetation and limestone formations dotted with numerous caves, including a climb to Soko Grad and the Golem Kamen viewpoint, and finishes along a forest trail toward Ozren and Ripaljka Waterfall. The trip lasts one day, departing from Belgrade in the early morning and returning in the evening. Participants must have a Planinarski savez Srbije membership booklet valid for 2026 and suitable hiking equipment.

name: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3
description: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3 is an exciting series of races held in Mionica, offering a range of distances for runners of different levels. The races include mountain and cycling marathons, as well as shorter courses, all set in the beautiful natural surroundings of Stara Planina. This event attracts nature and sports enthusiasts, offering challenging and scenic routes. You are welcome to take part and enjoy the unique atmosphere and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A variety of courses from 7 km to 60 km
Mountain and cycling marathons on Stara Planina
Beautiful natural landscapes and challenging terrain

name: V. Tisza-tavi Sportpiknik, Tömegsport Hétvége
description: A V. Tisza-tavi Sportpiknik és Tömegsport Hétvége 2026. május 30-31-én kerül megrendezésre Sarudon, a Tisza-tó partján. Ez a rendezvény egy közösségi sportesemény, amely a mozgás örömét és a természet közelségét kínálja a résztvevőknek. A programok között különféle sportesemények és családi programok is szerepelnek, így minden korosztály számára élményt nyújt. A helyszín a Tisza-tó gyönyörű környezete, amely ideális a kikapcsolódásra és aktív pihenésre.

name: Hegyen-Völgyön futás
description: A Hegyen-Völgyön futás egy terepfutó verseny, amely Tardos festői focipályáján kerül megrendezésre. A Sprint Futóklub szervezésében zajló esemény a természet közelségét és a változatos terepet kínálja a futás szerelmeseinek. A verseny a sport és a mozgás örömét hivatott népszerűsíteni, minden aktív életet kedvelőt szeretettel várnak. A szervezők fenntartják az időpont és programváltoztatás jogát.

name: HEGYEN-VÖLGYÖN FUTÁS
description: A Hegyen-Völgyön Futás egy hagyományos, sportkedvelők számára szervezett futóverseny Tardoson, amelyet a Sprint Futóklub rendez. A verseny három különböző távon kínál kihívást: 200 méteres gyerekfutás, valamint 4 és 12 kilométeres távok a komolyabb futóknak. A rajt a tardosi sportpályáról indul, és a verseny chipes időméréssel zajlik, biztosítva a pontos eredményeket. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és évről évre sok futót vonz a környékről.

name: Transylvania 100
location: Castelul Bran, Bran, Brașov County, Romania
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain running event offering five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, held in the Bucegi Mountains. The routes cross narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines, with numerous climbs and descents, all starting and finishing at Bran Castle, in the shadow of the legendary Dracula. The event is recognised as a UTMB Index race and promotes values such as respect, solidarity and self-sufficiency in mountain running. Participants must have prior mountain-running experience for the longer races, and everyone who finishes within the time limits receives a special souvenir.
course_highlights: Routes through narrow trails and ancient forests
Course across mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines
Start and finish near Bran Castle
additional: SportHG technical T-shirts are available until 1 May 2026, after which they will be replaced by neck warmers. Participation limits and prior experience are mandatory for races over 20 km. All races are solo, with strict self-sufficiency rules between checkpoints. The event includes races for different experience levels, with prizes for winners and medals for all finishers. Participation requires trail-running experience, and registration is online, with limited places.

name: Maratonul Internațional Sibiu
location: Piața Mare, Sibiu, Sibiu County, Romania

price_tiers.distance: Pași pentru oraș by Bilstein 3.35 km

description: Sibiu International Marathon is Romania’s largest philanthropic running event, reaching its 15th edition in 2026. The event combines the joy of running with support for community projects, with runners able to choose to support various local causes through their entry fee. The event features multiple races for all ages and levels, from the full marathon to children’s races, held in Sibiu’s Great Square and surrounding areas. It is a movement that unites and inspires communities, with a strong tradition and significant social impact.
course_highlights: Multiple races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay and children’s races
Start and finish in Great Square, Sibiu
A philanthropic event supporting local community projects
additional: Entry fees are considered donations supporting community projects. The event includes races for all ages, including children’s races and a relay. The registration deadline is 4 May 2026. It features multiple races, a registration deadline of 4 May 2026, donation-based fees, and a focus on social and community causes.

name: BRASOV MARATHON Eveniment organizat de CPNT Brașov
description: Brașov Marathon is one of Romania’s largest mountain running events, held in the heart of the Carpathians, around the city of Brașov. The courses include the 10K Cross, Half Marathon, Marathon, and Ultra Marathon, crossing the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs and offering impressive views and a unique combination of sport and nature. The event starts in Piața Sfatului, passes historic and natural landmarks, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit, offering ITRA and UTMB points. It is a celebration of health and sport, open to runners of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Mountain routes across the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs
Start and finish in Piața Sfatului, passing the Black Church and the Weavers’ Bastion
Panoramic views of Brașov and the surrounding area
additional: Race kits can be collected in Piața Sfatului, with specific hours for each race. The Ultra Marathon starts at 08:00, while the Half Marathon starts in two waves. Mandatory gear checks apply to the Ultra Marathon, Marathon, and Half Marathon. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, held over three days. The start area offers refreshments between 10:30 and 23:00. The event includes races for children and people with special abilities, and is dedicated to promoting running, nature, and the local community.

name: Crosul Teiușului
description: Crosul Teiușului este un eveniment sportiv dedicat promovării mișcării în aer liber, a alergării montane și a unui stil de viață sănătos, adresat tuturor vârstelor și nivelurilor de pregătire. Evenimentul oferă trasee variate, de la curse pentru copii până la semimaraton, într-un cadru natural autentic din Teiuș, Alba. Promovează incluziunea, spiritul de fair-play și participarea activă a comunității, oferind acces gratuit tuturor participanților. Este o tradiție locală care crește anual, aducând împreună sportivi și susținători pentru o experiență memorabilă.

name: Giarmata În Mișcare
description: Giarmata on the Move is an annual sporting event that brings together the communities of Giarmata and Cerneteaz to support social and educational causes and animal protection. In 2026, the event will take place on May 30 and will offer running races and cycling tours for all ages, from children to adults. Participants can choose from a half marathon, races of various distances, cycling tours, and children’s races, all helping to support local community projects. The event is organized by LOGS together with local partners and supported by major sponsors.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon for adults (ages 16+)
10.5 km and 5 km races for adults and young people
Races and tours for children aged 4 to 12
additional: The event includes races for all ages, from young children (400 m) to the half marathon. Participation supports community projects for children with disabilities, education, and animal protection. Donations can also be made separately by bank transfer or PayPal to the LOGS Association. The organizers provide support and information by email for payment confirmations and registration questions. The event includes donations and social projects, is supported by several local partners, and aims to promote health and civic engagement.

name: Thermal Trail Race
description: Thermal Trail Race este o cursă de alergare în aer liber ce promovează un stil de viață sănătos și respectul față de natură. Evenimentul are loc la Băile 1 Mai, cu startul și finishul în parcarea de la Avenul Betfia (Crater). Sunt disponibile două probe: Cross de 14 km și Mini de 7 km, oferind o experiență de trail running în peisajul natural al capitalei apelor termale. Aceasta este ediția a 13-a a evenimentului, care adună pasionați de alergare și natură într-un cadru prietenos și activ.

name: Forest Run
description: Baneasa Forest Run este o cursă de alergare 100% trail în Pădurea Băneasa, Cluj-Napoca, care oferă o experiență autentică în natură. Evenimentul include patru probe: semimaraton, cros de 11 km, alergare rapidă de 6 km și Family Run de 3 km, necompetitivă, pentru familii. Cursa este dedicată tuturor nivelurilor de alergători, de la începători la avansați, și pune accent pe bucuria alergării în pădure. Organizat de o echipă pasionată, evenimentul oferă și planuri de antrenament și antrenamente de grup pentru pregătire optimă.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baneasaforestrun.ro/): 2026-11-01 — "Băneasa Forest Run — 1 noiembrie 2026" (was estimated 2027-06-05)

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON TRAKIA UTRA is a mountain running event that recreates the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances suitable for beginners, advanced runners, and experts, including ultralong courses with stunning views and challenges. It is an event that combines sporting spirit, history, and a love of nature, creating an unforgettable experience for all participants. Join us and discover the magic of Thrace in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.

name: Мемориал "Йорданка Аризанова"
description: The “Yordanka Arizanova” Memorial is an annual competition dedicated to the memory of the legendary coach Yordanka Arizanova, who developed hundreds of accomplished athletes. The tournament is held at Plovdiv Stadium and includes events such as the 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, and 400 m hurdles, in which the coach achieved her greatest successes. The competition brings together both young and established athletes to honor her legacy and contribution to Bulgarian athletics.

name: Stazama Vuka Karadžića
description: The Vuk Karadžić Trails is a 25 km loop race with a total elevation gain of 1,000 metres. The course starts at Vuk’s memorial house and runs through the shade of the centuries-old Monastery Forests, past woodland streams and waterfalls to the 13th-century Tronoša Monastery. It then continues across Mala Tronoša and Lisina to Zajača, from where the Monastery Candles Trail leads to Velika Bobija and the Miličin Konak ethno complex, before returning to Tršić and Vuk’s house, where the finish is located. This race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the region’s natural beauty and cultural and historical landmarks.

name: Kros Trka Carica
description: The Carica Cross-Country Race is a traditional outdoor race held in Mali Stapar, bringing together runners of all ages, from children to competitors over seventy. The main race is 6.4 km long, preceded by children’s races with around forty participants. The event celebrates the traditions of sport, friendship, and spending time outdoors, and the organizers invite everyone to take part and enjoy this sporting event. The race is a prelude to the Friendship Race held in Kula, continuing the tradition of sport and community.

name: V. Kastélykör Flow 5 / 10 / 20
description: A V. Kastélykör Flow futóverseny egy családbarát, szabadidős esemény, amely a festői Károlyi kastély és kert környezetében, a Natura 2000 védett területen kerül megrendezésre Füzérradványban. A verseny változatos távokat kínál minden korosztálynak, 5, 10 és 20 km-es felnőtt körökkel, valamint rövidebb gyerek távokkal. A futók a kastélykert híres sétányain haladnak, és kutyával is lehet futni meghatározott szabályok szerint. Az esemény az Ötpróba program része, és a résztvevők számára számos kényelmi szolgáltatás áll rendelkezésre, mint csomagmegőrzés, öltözősátor és mosdó.

name: Zsámbékfutás 5 / 10 / 21
description: A Zsámbékfutás egy családbarát futóverseny, amely három távon kínál lehetőséget: 5 km, 10 km és félmaraton (21,2 km). A verseny útvonala Zsámbék és Tök településeken halad, aszfaltos és murvás útburkolaton, a félmaraton második fele pedig terepfutás a Nyakas-hegy környékén. A pálya változatos, szép kilátásokkal és több frissítőponttal várja a résztvevőket. A rendezvény célja, hogy mindenki megtalálja a számára megfelelő távot, miközben élvezheti a Zsámbéki-medence természeti szépségeit.

name: KASTÉLYKÖR FLOW
organizer: Laktát Sport Team és Kállai Krisztina
description: A V. Kastélykör Flow egy hangulatos futóesemény Füzérradványban, a Károlyi-kastély körül. A verseny a természet és a kastély történelmi környezetének élvezetét ötvözi, ideális választás mind a hobbi, mind a tapasztalt futók számára. A rendezvényt a Laktát Sport Team és Kállai Krisztina szervezi, akik szeretettel várják a résztvevőket 2026. május 31-én.

name: SÜLYSÁPI FUTÓNAP
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 10 km, 3.7 km, 2 km, 1500 meter, 0.3 km

name: Crosul Copiilor
location: Veneția de Jos, Brașov County, Romania

name: 7 Hills Run
description: 7 Hills Run is part of the RunBG Trail Series and takes place in the village of Zhelyava, Sofia. This is a challenging race that attracts mountain running and nature enthusiasts. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy beautiful landscapes and varied terrain in the Sofia area. The organizers provide professional organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.

name: Купа Мургаш 2026
description: Murgash Cup 2026 is the 17th edition of a mountain biking cross-country marathon (XCM) race held in the village of Zhelyava. The race offers three main routes of varying lengths and elevation gain, suitable for different categories of riders, including hobby riders and e-bikes. The routes pass through scenic and challenging terrain, including the famous Zhelyava Trail, which is popular with cyclists. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes, and the event is suitable for intermediate and well-prepared cyclists.

name: Humanitarna IT trka „Štafeta srcem”
description: The charity IT race “Štafeta srcem” will take place on June 5, 2026, at Niš Fortress. This event brings together the IT community and running enthusiasts in a charitable atmosphere, promoting solidarity and support through sport. The race is an opportunity to socialize, stay active, and contribute to the community in the beautiful surroundings of the fortress.

name: Macin Mountain Fun ~ 2026
description: Măcin Mountain Fun este o competiție montană de ciclism și alergare care se desfășoară în peisajul spectaculos al Munților Măcin. Traseele oferă o varietate de dificultăți, de la rute tehnice și solicitante pentru cicliști experimentați, până la trasee mai accesibile pentru amatori. Evenimentul pune accent pe siguranță, fair play și distracție, fiind potrivit pentru pasionații de sport în aer liber care doresc să se bucure de natură și provocări sportive. Înscrierile se fac online, iar organizatorii asigură o experiență bine organizată și prietenoasă.

name: Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail
description: The Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail is a race held in honor of Serbia’s first Olympian, Dušan Milošević, and takes runners along the most beautiful trails of Rudnik. The race is dedicated to his courage and perseverance, and aims to honor his legacy and the Serbian spirit through running. Three courses are available: the fast, shorter Vihor course; the more challenging Rudnik course, with steep climbs and descents; and the non-competitive Domaćinska course for those who want to enjoy nature. The race is an opportunity to celebrate history, courage, and community.

name: Kup Fruške Gore 2026
description: The Fruška Gora Cup 2026 is a traditional sports, competition and recreation event held on Fruška Gora. The races cover a range of trails, including the ultra-extreme marathon, ultra marathon, middle eastern marathon and beginner trails, with varying levels of difficulty and distance. The event brings together runners from Serbia and abroad, offering challenges on Fruška Gora’s old trails and a chance to enjoy nature and the spirit of sport. The organizers also provide transportation to the start and extensive support throughout the event.

name: Serbia EPIC VRNJAČKA BANJA #4
description: The UCI XCO race in Andrevlje is an exciting competition that brings together elite and junior riders in the men's and women's categories. Held in front of the Ceptor Hotel amid the beautiful surroundings of Andrevlje, it lasts four days and offers an outstanding atmosphere and intense competition. Riders can expect electronic timing, fully marked trails, and a comprehensive race pack with a T-shirt, medal, and refreshments on the course. This is an event that combines a passion for sport with the natural beauty of Serbia.

name: XXIV. Büchl Éjszakai Futóverseny
description: A XXIV. Büchl Éjszakai Futóverseny 2026. június 6-án kerül megrendezésre Győrben, a Tulipános Általános Iskolánál. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget, köztük gyerekfutam, 7, 14 és 21 km-es egyéni futás, 3 fős félmaraton váltó, valamint 7 km-es Nordic Walking. A verseny egyedi befutóérmet, chipes időmérést, frissítést és orvosi ügyeletet biztosít, a pályák jól jelöltek és rendőri biztosítással ellátottak. A rajtcsomag a hosszabb távokon indulóknak jár, és a nevezés előzetes regisztrációval, banki utalással válik véglegessé.

name: Büchl Éjszakai Félmaraton
description: A Büchl Éjszakai Félmaraton egy hagyományos, éjszakai futóverseny Győrben, amely több távon kínál lehetőséget a futás szerelmeseinek, beleértve a gyerekfutamot, egyéni távokat és váltókat is. A verseny központja a Tulipános Általános Iskola, és a rendezvény jól szervezett, chipes időméréssel, frissítési pontokkal, orvosi ügyelettel és rendőri biztosítással várja a résztvevőket. A nevezők egyedi befutóérmet kapnak, és a 14 és 21 km-es távokon rajtcsomagot is biztosítanak. A verseny célja, hogy minden korosztály számára élvezetes és biztonságos futóélményt nyújtson.

name: Bükk Hegyi Maraton
description: A Bükki Hegyi Maraton-Kisgyörgy Ádám Emlékverseny Magyarország legrégebbi terepmaratonja, amely 2026. június 6-án kerül megrendezésre Miskolc, Majális parkban. A verseny változatos távokat kínál, a maratontól a minimaratonig, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára ideális kihívást. A futók a festői Bükk-hegység természeti szépségei között versenyeznek, miközben a versenyközpontban az „erdei stadionban” folyamatosan követhető a verseny alakulása. A rendezvény célja a sportbarátságok ápolása, az egészséges életmód népszerűsítése és a Bükk természeti értékeinek bemutatása.

name: Ceglédfürdő Futófesztivál
description: Az V. Ceglédfürdő Futófesztivál 2026. június 6-án kerül megrendezésre a Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő és Szabadidőközpontban. A rendezvény célja az egészséges életmód népszerűsítése és a futás örömének megismertetése minden korosztály számára. A versenyen számos táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, a legkisebbeknek 300 méteres tipegőtől a félmaratonig és váltóversenyekig. A futók a gyönyörű tó és a fürdő látványában gyönyörködhetnek, miközben a rekortán jellegű futópályán haladnak. A versenyhez kapcsolódó programok, díjazások és a fürdőbelépő tovább növeli az élményt.

name: Crazy5K
description: A CRAZY5K egy egyedi, 5 km-es akadályfutó verseny, amelyen 10 hatalmas, felfújható akadály várja a résztvevőket. A verseny nem a teljesítményről, hanem a szórakozásról szól, így barátokkal, családdal vagy kollégákkal együtt élvezhető egy felejthetetlen nap. Külön családi futam is elérhető, amely kifejezetten a 10 év alatti gyermekes családoknak szól, és a gyerekeknek meglepetéssel készülnek. A rendezvény helyszíne a Budaörsi Repülőtér, ahol parkolási lehetőség is biztosított. A nevezési díj tartalmaz rajtszámot, pólót, befutócsomagot, egyedi érmet, frissítést, ruhatárhasználatot és orvosi felügyeletet.

name: MOKÜ Run
location: Kismaros Focipálya, Liget utca, Kismaros, Hungary

name: XRun
description: X-Run is a running competition held in Oradea on June 6, 2026, organized by the Xterra Sport Bihor Sports Club Association. The 21 km course offers a complete experience, with refreshment stations providing still water, isotonic drinks, cola, ice, fresh fruit, and energy bars. Participants receive a race pack containing a personalized technical shirt, race number, and electronic timing chip. Medical assistance is provided along the course by ambulances and specialized personnel. Race pack pickup takes place on Friday, June 5, 2026, from 16:00 to 20:00.
course_highlights: 21 km course in Oradea, Bihor County
Refreshment stations with drinks and energy snacks
Medical assistance along the course from ambulances and specialized personnel
additional: Race pack pickup takes place on Friday, June 5, 2026, from 16:00 to 20:00. The race pack includes an official personalized technical shirt, race number, and electronic timing chip. Medical assistance is provided by specially equipped ambulances and medical staff at key points along the course. Participants must present a signed declaration of responsibility and their identity card or passport. The entry fee is non-refundable if a participant withdraws, but the entry can be transferred until 16.05.2026. The event will take place on June 6, 2026, with participant facilities including race packs, hydration stations, and medical support.

name: Bușteni Ultra Race
description: Bușteni Ultra Race is a mountain running competition held on spectacular routes in the Bucegi and Baiului Mountains, offering impressive panoramic views. The event features four distances with significant elevation gain, designed to test participants’ physical and mental limits. The atmosphere is one of community and mutual support, while careful organization ensures a safe and professional experience. Participants can reconnect with nature and take on the challenge of an authentic endurance race.
course_highlights: Alpine routes with impressive panoramic views
Significant elevation gain for each distance
Marked routes and well-stocked aid stations
additional: Race kit pickup is on Friday 05.06.2026, between 15:00 and 22:00, for BBB Ultra 60; mandatory gear checks apply, and pickup is for participants only. For the other distances, kits can be picked up on Saturday 06.06.2026, between 7:00 and 9:30. The kit includes a personalized technical shirt for the first 800 participants, timing with a single-use chip, aid stations along the route and at the start/finish, a finisher medal for those who finish within the time limits, and products provided by sponsors. There are time limits for each distance and an awards ceremony at 18:00. The routes include aid and support points, with categories and prizes for different distances. The event promotes an authentic mountain trail experience and participant safety.

name: msg Maraton Apuseni
organizer: Clubul Alpin Român Filiala Cluj și msg Maraton Apuseni
description: .msg Maraton Apuseni este un eveniment emblematic de alergare montană care se desfășoară în peisajele pitorești ale Munților Apuseni, în zona Buscat Resort, Județul Cluj. Concursul oferă cinci trasee variate, de la ultramaraton și maraton, până la semimaraton, cros și o cursă family dedicată copiilor și părinților. Participanții se bucură de o experiență autentică în natură, traversând păduri dese, creste spectaculoase și sate tradiționale, într-o atmosferă prietenoasă și festivă. Evenimentul este organizat de Clubul Alpin Român Filiala Cluj și sărbătorește în 2026 cea de-a 15-a ediție, promițând provocări sportive și momente de socializare în ritmul muntelui.

name: Maraton Apuseni ~ 2026
description: .msg Maraton Apuseni este un eveniment emblematic de alergare montană care se desfășoară în inima Munților Apuseni, oferind trasee variate pentru toate gusturile și nivelurile de experiență. Participanții pot alege între ultramaraton, maraton, semimaraton, cros și o cursă family, bucurându-se de peisaje pitorești, poteci umbrite, creste spectaculoase și sate tradiționale. Evenimentul sărbătorește 15 ani de tradiție și comunitate, fiind organizat de Clubul Alpin Român Filiala Cluj, cu o atmosferă prietenoasă și festivă. Este o oportunitate unică de a alerga în natură, de a-ți testa limitele și de a te conecta cu alți pasionați de alergare montană.

name: Măcin Mountain Fun
description: Măcin Mountain Fun este o competiție montană de ciclism organizată în zona Greci, județul Tulcea, care pune accent pe distracție și fair play. Traseele sunt montane, solicitante, dar accesibile, oferind participanților o experiență autentică în natură. Evenimentul este destinat atât cicliștilor experimentați, cât și celor care doresc să se bucure de o zi activă în aer liber, într-un cadru prietenos și bine organizat.

name: MARATON APUSENI
description: .msg Maraton Apuseni este un eveniment emblematic de alergare montană care se desfășoară în inima Munților Apuseni, oferind trasee variate pentru toate gusturile și nivelurile de experiență. Participanții pot alege între ultramaraton, maraton, semimaraton, cros și o cursă family, bucurându-se de peisaje pitorești, poteci umbrite, creste spectaculoase și sate tradiționale. Evenimentul sărbătorește 15 ani de tradiție și comunitate, fiind organizat cu pasiune de Clubul Alpin Român Filiala Cluj. Atmosfera de festival și provocarea sportivă se îmbină pentru a crea o experiență memorabilă în natură.

name: ROMANAȚI Trail Run, editia a V-a ~ 6 iunie 2026
description: Romanați Trail Run este o cursă vibrantă de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în Caracal, transformând orașul în capitala trail running-ului pentru o zi. Evenimentul oferă trei trasee provocatoare, potrivite pentru toate nivelurile de alergători, cu o atmosferă prietenoasă și o comunitate pasionată de mișcare. Cursa are un caracter sportiv și caritabil, promovând valorile sportului și spiritul de echipă. Startul competiției este programat la ora 10:00, iar participanții pot alege între semimaraton și două curse de cros.

name: Salomon Vitosha Trail
description: Salomon Vitosha Trail 2026 is a mountain race offering a unique experience in the wild nature of Vitosha. The race includes three distances of varying difficulty and elevation gain, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Aleko Hut, and the courses cross varied terrain, including an ascent of Cherni Vrah—the highest point on Vitosha. The organizers aim to develop trail-running culture in Bulgaria and encourage an active lifestyle.

name: Национален шампионат под 18 г.
description: The U18 National Championships in Stara Zagora is a prestigious athletics competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The event brings together young athletes under 18 who compete in various track events. It is part of the national calendar and provides an opportunity for young athletics talents to compete and develop.

name: Village Trail
description: Village Trail 2026 is the third edition of the race, held in Višnjica, on the outskirts of Belgrade, on June 7, 2026. The race combines sport, nature, and adventure, with two courses winding through beautiful scenery, including a viewpoint overlooking the Danube and Belgrade. The start and finish are at Dunavska terasa restaurant, and the event is suitable for experienced runners and beginners. An entertainment program is provided for children and families, while runners can look forward to support from volunteers and an after-run party.

name: 31. ALDI Női Futógála
description: A 31. ALDI Női Futógála egy különleges futóesemény, amely 2026. június 7-én kerül megrendezésre a budapesti Városligetben. A versenyen több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást, legyen az 2,5 km, 5 km vagy 10 km. A futógála célja, hogy a résztvevők kiszakadjanak a mindennapokból, élvezzék a mozgás szabadságát, és egy közösségi élmény részesei legyenek. A célban egyedi befutóérem és futópóló várja a futókat, hogy emlékezetessé tegye ezt a napot.

name: Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Futás 9 / 21
description: A Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Futás egy aszfaltos futóverseny, amely Pécs, Orfű és Abaliget településeket köti össze, 465 méter szintemelkedéssel. A verseny célja a helyi futóközösségek összekapcsolása és a futás népszerűsítése a dombok és tavak között. A rendezvény hagyományosan június elején kerül megrendezésre, és több távon kínál lehetőséget a részvételre, beleértve a gyerekfutamot is. A szervezők szeretettel várják a futókat, hogy együtt élvezzék a természetet és a közösségi élményt.

name: PÉCS -> ORFŰ -> ABALIGET FÉLMARATON
description: A Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Futás egy aszfaltos félmaraton, amely Pécs, Orfű és Abaliget településeket köti össze, 465 méter szintemelkedéssel. A verseny célja a helyi futóközösségek összekapcsolása és a futás népszerűsítése a dombok és tavak között. A rendezvény hagyományosan június elején kerül megrendezésre, és családbarát programokat is kínál, például gyerekfutamot. A szervezők a helyi közösségek és az egyetem támogatásával várják a futókat, hogy együtt élvezzék a természetet és a sportot.

name: ALDI NŐI FUTÓGÁLA (31.)
description: A 31. ALDI Női Futógála egy különleges futóesemény, amely 2026. június 7-én kerül megrendezésre a budapesti Népligetben. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget a részvételre, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára legmegfelelőbb kihívást, legyen az 2,5 km, 5 km vagy 10 km, illetve váltó és gyaloglás is választható. A rendezvény célja, hogy a résztvevők kiszakadjanak a mindennapokból, és élvezzék a mozgás szabadságát egy barátságos, női közösségben. A célban egyedi befutóérem és futópóló várja a résztvevőket, hogy emlékezetessé tegye ezt a napot.

name: Tinca Cross
description: Tinca Cross este un concurs de alergare organizat de ACS Bihorul Oradea în parteneriat cu Primăria Tinca și Consiliul Local, ce se desfășoară în data de 7 iunie 2026. Evenimentul include probe de cros pe distanțele de 5 km și 10 km, potrivite pentru alergători de anduranță cu vârsta minimă de 14 ani. Traseul pornește de pe stadionul comunal Tinca și se desfășoară pe o buclă de 2,5 km în pădurea aferentă stadionului, cu finish pe stadion. Participanții sub 18 ani au nevoie de acordul scris al unui părinte sau tutore. Se oferă premii în bani și diplome pentru locurile fruntașe.

name: Rhodo Rock
description: Rhodo Rock is a remarkable ultramarathon held in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains, near the town of Momchilgrad. This unique sporting event brings together participants from around the world who love the challenges of mountain trails and the beauty of nature. The race offers a variety of routes featuring peaks, valleys, rivers, and forest trails, suitable for both professional athletes and outdoor adventure enthusiasts. Participants can look forward to an exciting experience and an atmosphere that combines sport and nature.

name: Business Run Sofia
description: Business Run Sofia is the largest team-building event in Bulgaria, bringing together employees from different companies for a corporate relay race. Teams have 4 participants, each of whom runs 4 laps of 1.2 km, for a total of 4.8 km. In addition to the relay, there are also a Power Walk, CEO Dash, and Kids Run. Every participant receives insurance, a medal, and gifts. The event is a great opportunity to strengthen team bonds and enjoy active recreation with colleagues.

name: Pedală în Bănie ~ 2026
description: Pedală în Bănie este un eveniment sportiv cu tradiție în regiunea Dolj, dedicat pasionaților de mountain bike și alergare trail. Evenimentul, desfășurat în zona Palilula din Craiova, oferă trasee inspirate de tema „JURASSIC”, cu provocări care testează forța, viteza și rezistența participanților. Cu curse variate pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile, Pedală în Bănie promovează sănătatea, spiritul comunitar și protecția mediului, fiind o experiență completă de competiție și aventură în natură. Atmosfera prietenoasă și organizarea atentă fac din acest eveniment o sărbătoare a sportului și a mișcării în aer liber.

name: Stara Planina 2026
description: Stara Planina Skiing 2026 is a four-day winter program offering skiing, sledding, walks, and socializing amid the unspoiled nature of Stara Planina. Enjoy the thrills and beautiful scenery at the Babin Zub ski resort, with over 13 kilometers of groomed runs of varying difficulty, including a freeride run and an artificial snowmaking system. The program is for skiers and winter sports enthusiasts, with departures from Belgrade and Niš and accommodation at Ždrma Inn. If there is not enough snow, hiking tours are organized, making the event accessible to nature lovers and those seeking an active holiday.

name: Brutálfutás 15.0
description: A Brutálfutás 15.0 egy könnyed akadályfutó verseny Nyáregyházán, ahol a résztvevők 2,3 vagy 7 kilométeres távokon teljesíthetnek egy katonai kiképzőpálya és akadályverseny keverékét. A verseny nem a teljesítményről, hanem a jó hangulatról és a felejthetetlen élményekről szól, ahol a sár és a víz garantált. Egyedi befutóéremmel és sok sárral várják a futókat, akik akár jótékony futóként is nevezhetnek. A rendezvény az ország több száz településéről vonzza a résztvevőket, és egy igazán szórakoztató, családias hangulatú esemény.

name: Bábolna Bio Sunset Run
description: A Bábolna Bio Sunset Run egy hangulatos esti futóverseny, amelyet 2026. június 13-án rendeznek meg Bábolna központjában, a Strand- és Termálfürdő előtt. A verseny során a futók érintik a lovardát, valamint a híres Bábolnai Arborétumot és Állatparkot. A versenyt naplementében indítják, extra hangulatvilágítással, és a résztvevők három táv közül választhatnak, köztük félmaraton váltóban is. A versenyzők prémium rajtcsomagot kapnak, BioTechUSA frissítéssel, és minden szintidőn belül célba érkező egyedi befutóéremmel gazdagodik.

name: Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök 3 / 7 / 14 / 21
location: Edelény, L'Huillier-Coburg kastély, Borsodi út 7, 3780 Magyarország
description: Az Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök egy hangulatos futóverseny, amely a L'Huillier-Coburg kastély környékén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget a futóknak, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A rendezvény ideális választás azoknak, akik szeretik a kastélypark különleges atmoszféráját és az esti futás élményét. A verseny szervezői professzionális időméréssel és kényelmes regisztrációs felülettel várják a résztvevőket.

name: UTBT (Ultra Tokaj-Bodrogkeresztúr-Tarcal)
description: Az Ultra Tokaj - Bodrogkeresztúr - Tarcal futóverseny egy kihívásokkal teli, 63 km-es ultra táv, amely a Tokaj-hegyalja festői szőlőültetvényei és dombjai között vezet. A verseny három különböző távon várja a futókat, hogy kezdők és tapasztaltak egyaránt megtalálják a számukra ideális kihívást. A rendezvény nemcsak egy futóverseny, hanem egy élmény, amely Magyarország egyik legszebb borvidékének tájain zajlik. A rajtok tömegrajtos formában indulnak, és a versenyzők frissítést kapnak az útvonalon és a célban is.

name: BRUTÁLFUTÁS
description: A Brutálfutás egy könnyed akadályfutó verseny Nyáregyházán, amely 2,3 és 7 kilométeres távokon kínál felejthetetlen, sáros és vízes élményt. A verseny katonai kiképzőpálya és akadályverseny keveréke, ahol a móka és a közösségi élmény áll a középpontban. Egyedi befutóéremmel és sok sárral várják a résztvevőket, akik az ország több száz településéről érkeznek. A verseny nem a komolyságról szól, hanem a szórakozásról és a kihívásról, így bárki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő távot.

name: Retezat Sky Race
description: Retezat SkyRace este o cursă de skyrunning desfășurată în peisajul spectaculos al Munților Retezat din România, oferind alergătorilor o experiență provocatoare pe trasee montane tehnice și variate. Evenimentul combină provocările terenului accidentat cu frumusețea naturală a crestelor, văilor și lacurilor alpine, fiind dedicat pasionaților de alergare montană și aventură. Organizată cu atenție la siguranță și respect pentru mediu, cursa oferă o comunitate pasionată și oportunități de socializare și autodepășire. Pe 13 iunie 2026, participanții vor putea experimenta o adevărată aventură montană în inima Retezatului.

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului (Deda)
description: Maraton Scaunul Domnului este o cursă montană provocatoare desfășurată în Rezervația Naturală Scaunul Domnului, aproape de Deda, Mureș. Evenimentul oferă mai multe probe, inclusiv maraton de 42 km, semimaraton de 21 km, cros de 10 km, precum și curse pentru familii și copii. Traseele combină urcări susținute, drumuri forestiere și segmente cu priveliști spectaculoase, fiind potrivite pentru alergători montani dornici de aventură și natură. Siguranța este o prioritate, cu verificări obligatorii de echipament și puncte de control pe traseu.

name: Maratonul Sării
description: Maratonul Sării este un eveniment sportiv care combină alergarea și ciclismul mountainbike, desfășurat în peisajul natural și istoric al orașului Târgu Ocna, județul Bacău. Participanții pot alege între curse de trail running de 10 km și 21 km, precum și o cursă de mountainbike de 30 km, toate având startul și finishul în Piața Primăriei. Un element unic al competiției este parcurgerea unui segment de 7 km prin galeriile subterane ale Salinei Târgu Ocna, oferind o experiență inedită și beneficii pentru sănătate datorită aerului ionizat. Evenimentul promovează un stil de viață activ și responsabil față de natură, implicând și acțiuni de plogging pentru ecologizarea traseelor.

name: Maraton Tarcău
location: Mănăstirea Tarcău, comuna Tarcău, jud. Neamţ
description: Maraton Tarcău este o competiție anuală desfășurată în peisajul natural al zonei Tarcău, Neamț, care oferă probe de maraton, semimaraton și cros. Evenimentul pune accent pe pregătirea fizică și echipamentul adecvat, asigurând o experiență sportivă completă și sigură. Participanții pot beneficia de kitul de participare oferit cu o zi înainte de concurs și trebuie să respecte regulamentul oficial al competiției. Timpurile limită pentru parcurgerea traseelor sunt bine stabilite pentru fiecare probă, asigurând un ritm competitiv și organizat.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://maraton-tarcau.ro/): 2027-06-12 — "Maraton Tarcau 12 IUNIE 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-19)

name: Semimaratonul Eroilor Invictus
description: Semimaratonul Eroilor Invictus, care va avea loc pe 23 mai 2026 în Bistrița, este un eveniment sportiv dedicat comemorării Zilei Eroilor și promovării activităților sportive de masă. Evenimentul aduce împreună comunitatea locală și sportivii amatori, oferind o cursă de semimaraton și alte probe sportive. Traseul pornește din Piața Centrală și străbate principalele artere ale orașului, fiind organizat sub patronajul Principelui Radu și cu sprijinul mai multor instituții și asociații locale. Participanții sunt încurajați să citească regulamentul, să se înscrie și să doneze pentru susținerea cauzei.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://semimaratonuleroilor.ro/regulament/): 2027-06-12 — "Evenimentul are loc în orașul Bistrița, în data de 12 iunie 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-29)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Evenimentul are loc în orașul Bistrița, în data de 12 iunie 2027

name: Atinge OMU
description: Atinge Omu este un concurs de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în Munții Bucegi, pe traseul Peștera - Vf. Omu - Peștera. Evenimentul are loc în prima decadă a lunii iunie, când peisajul este dominat de culmile înroșite de rododendron. Cursa oferă alergătorilor o combinație de intensitate și frumusețe naturală, iar la final participanții sunt răsplătiți cu bulz perpelit și jintiță. Este o experiență montană autentică, cu startul de la telecabina Peștera și o atmosferă prietenoasă și tradițională.

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului
description: Maraton Scaunul Domnului este o cursă montană provocatoare ce se desfășoară în Rezervația Naturală Scaunul Domnului, în apropiere de Bistra Mureșului. Evenimentul oferă mai multe probe, inclusiv maraton de 42 km cu diferență de nivel de peste 2100 m, semimaraton, cros de 10 km, precum și curse pentru familii și copii. Traseul maratonului trece prin peisaje spectaculoase, cu puncte de alimentare și control, și include porțiuni de drum forestier, trasee nemarcate și zone cu belvedere. Siguranța este o prioritate, cu verificare obligatorie a echipamentului și timpi limita pentru fiecare probă. Atmosfera este completată de festivități de premiere și un foc de tabără după concurs.

name: PENIEL TRAIL RUN
description: Peniel Trail Run este un eveniment de alergare în natură, desfășurat pe trasee de trail în zona Bistrița, care promovează sănătatea prin mișcare, comunitate și adevăr. Evenimentul oferă curse pentru toate nivelurile, de la semimaraton pentru alergătorii experimentați, la curse de 10 km și 5 km, precum și o cursă pentru copii. Peniel Trail Run este mai mult decât o competiție sportivă, fiind o chemare la o viață trăită deplin pentru trup, minte și duh, cu un mesaj profund de direcție și relație vie cu Dumnezeu. Numele Peniel simbolizează „locul întâlnirii”, unde sportul, comunitatea și credința se întâlnesc autentic și relevant pentru generația de astăzi.

name: Тепе Джамборе 2026 Tepe Jambore
location: Летен театър, Пловдив, Пловдивска област, България
description: Tepe Jambore is a sports and cultural marathon in Plovdiv, combining running, movement, and culture across the city center and its hills. The event offers a unique urban adventure with artistic and cultural performances, including jazz music, theater, and dance, turning running into a celebration of sport and culture. The routes pass through landmark city locations, hills, paths, and green spaces, and are suitable for all ages and fitness levels. This is not a standard race, but an experience that brings the community together and supports causes for people facing social disadvantage.
course_highlights: Champions’ Jambore — 13 km with 450 meters of elevation gain, passing over all of Plovdiv’s hills
Laid-Back Jambore — 7 km with 250 meters of elevation gain
Kids’ Jambore — 1 km in Bunardzhik Park, on a safe route in a supervised environment
additional: The event includes cultural stops featuring theater, music, dance, beer and wine with snacks, performers, and surprises. The start-finish area hosts a party with music and entertainment. Participants can volunteer with the Jambore Squad, helping support participants and the event organization. Corporate teams take part in a competition that celebrates team spirit and raises donations for the “Plovdiv112” volunteer formation. The routes include 13 km, 7 km, and 1 km options; the event is part of Plovdiv’s 2026 cultural calendar and offers entertainment for the whole family.

name: ДИВОТО ЗОВЕ МАДЖАРОВО 2026
description: Wild Calls Madzharovo is an annual event combining cycling and trail running in the scenic Eastern Rhodopes. It takes place in the town of Madzharovo, situated in the crater of an ancient volcano and surrounded by unique natural landscapes and historic landmarks. The courses offer a variety of distances and challenges suitable for both recreational and elite athletes. Organized by the Dimitar Madzharov Cycling Club, the event aims to showcase the region’s beauty and bring sports enthusiasts together in a spirit of adventure and respect for nature.
course_highlights: Trail running with up to 900 m of elevation gain and panoramic views of Botev Peak
Routes passing through dense forests and old trails, and near a waterfall
Unique natural scenery in a volcanic crater, close to the Arda River and its striking meanders
additional: Start and finish at the square in front of the Municipality in Madzharovo. Services include chip timing, mountain rescue, emergency medical assistance, a tasty lunch in the festival area, and the option to camp in the Arda River canyon or at a campsite in the town park. Multiple MTB, duathlon, and trail running distances; starts on June 13 and 14, 2026, including children’s races and eco activities.

name: Национален шампионат под 14г
description: The National Championship for under-14 competitors in Gabrovo is a two-day athletics event that brings together more than 300 young athletes from across the country. Held at Hristo Botev Stadium, it gives the youngest talents an opportunity to compete in classic track and field events. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sports calendar and takes place alongside the international Nikola Valchanov Tournament. It is a significant event that supports the development of young athletes and promotes athletics in the region.

name: Турнир "Никола Вълчанов"
description: The Nikola Valchanov Athletics Tournament in Gabrovo is a traditional sporting event held at Aprilov Stadium. It features 17 events, including sprint races and shot put, for age groups ranging from under 14 to men and women. The organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATHLET athletics club. The event attracts both young and experienced athletes and opens officially at 11:00.

name: Отвъд Мостъ / Beyond the Bridge
description: Beyond the Bridge is a unique bike-and-run event in Lovech that combines a sporting challenge with historical and natural landmarks. Participants cross four iconic bridges and follow scenic routes that include the Devetashko Plateau, the Kakrina Inn, Hisarya Fortress, and the Bash Bunar and Stratesh parks. The event is suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners, with 20% of the fees going to a charitable cause. It’s an opportunity to enjoy nature and history and experience an unforgettable adventure.

name: Sunrise Marathon
description: The Sunrise Marathon in Bačka Palanka supports the mission of the Sunrise Association, an organization that provides free summer day camps for children with cancer and their siblings. Runners are invited to join Team Sunrise and help bring joy and happiness back to children battling this disease through running and fundraising. By taking part in the race, participants have the opportunity to support unique programs and camps that bring smiles and hope to children around the world.

name: Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail offers a unique running experience along the Gradac River, known for its unspoiled nature and crystal-clear water. The course winds through a canyon rich in wildlife and varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky riverbanks, and stream crossings. This race combines natural beauty and adventure, making it ideal for runners who want to experience trail running at its most scenic. It takes place in Valjevo, Serbia, and is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia.

name: X. Sopron Trail 5 / 10 / 25
organizer: Sopron Város Polgármesteri Hivatal Sportfelügyeleti Csoportja, SMAFC Tájfutó Szakosztálya, SMAFC Tájfutó Sportjáért Alapítvány, Sopron-Trail
description: A Sopron Trail 2026 terepfutóverseny Sopron-Brennbergbánya festői környezetében kerül megrendezésre 2026. június 14-én. A verseny célja a terepfutás népszerűsítése és a Soproni-hegység vadregényes részeinek bemutatása. Több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, köztük 5.9 km, 10.7 km és 25.9 km, melyek között az Alpokalja Terepkirály futósorozat része is megtalálható. A verseny különleges extra kihívást is kínál egy időméréses emelkedő szakaszon, ahol a legjobb férfi és női futó különdíjat kap. A versenyközpont a Brennbergbánya Kultúrházában található, ahol mosdó és zuhanyzó is rendelkezésre áll.

name: CROSSKOVÁCSI Dockyard Terepfutó verseny
description: A Crosskovácsi Dockyard Terepfutó verseny egy változatos távokat kínáló terepfutó esemény Nagykovácsi festői környezetében, a Teleki-Tisza-kastély környékén. A verseny négy távon zajlik: mini (3 km), rövid (7 km), középtáv (13,5 km) és hegyi félmaraton (21,7 km), mindegyik egy 1 km-es felvezető körrel indul a kastélyparkban. A pályák változatos terepen haladnak, jelentős szintemelkedéssel, és a résztvevők frissítőpontokon kaphatnak ellátást. Minden célba érkező emlékérmet kap, a verseny elektronikus időméréssel zajlik, és a szervezők kiemelt figyelmet fordítanak a versenyzők biztonságára és egészségügyi ellátására.

name: Crosul Supereroilor
description: The Superheroes Run is an energizing race that brings together thousands of participants in Cluj-Napoca as part of Sports Festival. The event promotes team spirit and fun, offering a unique sporting experience in the heart of the city. Participants can enjoy a vibrant atmosphere and challenges on routes adapted for all ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Urban route in the Cluj Arena area
Part of Sports Festival
Friendly, energizing atmosphere for all ages
additional: The 2025 edition took place at Cluj Arena, and half of the registration fee was donated to the Via Transilvanica project of the Tășuleasa Social Association. Registration details and the fee for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Topoloveni Summer Tour ~ 2026
description: Topoloveni Summer Tour este un eveniment dedicat cicliștilor amatori din România, organizat de Riders Club. Participanții pot alege să se bucure de o plimbare în aer liber sau să concureze pentru a-și câștiga locul în clasamentele naționale de ciclism pentru amatori. Traseul este pregătit cu grijă pentru a proteja mediul natural, iar marcajele vor fi limitate pentru a respecta pădurile și zonele naturale. Evenimentul oferă oportunități pentru toate vârstele, inclusiv curse pentru copii și opțiuni pentru familii cu discounturi speciale. În cazul condițiilor meteo nefavorabile, cursa poate fi reprogramată pentru o dată de rezervă.

name: Run for Heroes
description: Run for Heroes este o cursă caritabilă anuală care se desfășoară pe 14 iunie 2026 în Parcul Herăstrău, București, pe Șoseaua Kiseleff. Evenimentul aduce împreună alergători de toate vârstele, familii și animale de companie pentru a susține servicii gratuite de psihoterapie. Traseele sunt accesibile și prietenoase, cu o atmosferă plină de energie, distracție și solidaritate, unde fiecare kilometru alergat contribuie la o cauză nobilă. Participanții primesc kituri tematice de supereroi și se bucură de o zi completă de activități sportive și recreative.

name: Triglav Skyrun
description: Triglav Skyrun is a unique mountain race held in Central Balkan National Park, Bulgaria. The course passes three iconic mountain huts—Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka—and includes a climb to the third-highest peak in the Balkan Mountains, Golyam Kademliya (2,275.4 m). The race offers three distances of varying difficulty, all starting from the picturesque village of Tazha, the starting point for all three routes. This event is for lovers of mountain running and nature, combining challenge with the beauty of the wild mountains.

name: Бягай бос с усмивка
description: Run Barefoot with a Smile is a unique event held in picturesque Belogradchik. The course offers the opportunity to run barefoot, combining sport and enjoyment amid nature. The event is suitable for anyone who wants to experience the freedom and joy of running without shoes in beautiful, inspiring surroundings.

name: Ultramaraton Palić
description: The Palić Ultramarathon is a national and international ultramarathon championship held in Palić and organized by the Ultramarathon Association of Serbia. The race includes several disciplines: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, starting and finishing at the Great Terrace. The competition is open to all ultramarathon runners who follow the rules, with participants competing in the overall and age categories. Alongside the competitive spirit, the race offers a well-stocked aid station, a communal lunch and prizes for the top finishers, as well as special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants.

name: Trka prijateljstva Kula
description: The Friendship Race in Kula is a traditional event held since 2009 that promotes sport, friendship, family values, and recreation. The race brings together amateur, recreational, and professional runners from the region and beyond, creating a unique running community. Over the years, it has become the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula, with more than 6,000 participants and a total of 34,000 kilometers run. The organizers continually improve the event, prizes, and organization to make the race even better and more appealing to all participants.

name: I. Szentivánéji Futótűz 5 / 10 / 21
description: Az I. Szentivánéji Futótűz egy éjszakai futófesztivál Balatonszárszón, a Tóparti parkban, amelyet Szent Iván éjszakáján rendeznek meg. A versenyen több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, beleértve a félmaratont, rövidebb futamokat és egy esti gyaloglást a Balaton partján. A rendezvény a nyári szezon kezdetét ünnepli, és a futók mellett családokat és közösségi sportkedvelőket is vár. A verseny az Ötpróba program része, amely pontgyűjtési lehetőséget kínál értékes jutalmakért.

name: SZENT LÁSZLÓ TEREPFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: A Szent László terepfutás egy hagyományos terepfutó verseny a Gerecse hegységben, Baj közelében, amelyet a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervez. A verseny a lövész és gyalogság fegyvernem védőszentjének, Szent Lászlónak tiszteletére kerül megrendezésre, és 2010 óta rendszeresen zajlik, egyetlen alkalommal, 2013-ban az árvíz miatt maradt el. A futók változatos terepen, erdei ösvényeken és dombos vidékeken mérhetik össze erejüket. A verseny jó hangulatú, közösségi esemény, amely a természetjárás és a sport iránt érdeklődőknek egyaránt ajánlott.

name: BALATON BAJNOKSÁG
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, 24 km, 12 km, 5 km, 5 km

name: Roșia Montană Marathon
description: Roșia Montană Marathon is a sporting, environmental, and socio-cultural event held in the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană, Alba County. The 13th edition, in 2026, celebrates the area’s nature, history, and cultural heritage, offering a variety of routes for runners of all levels. Races include a marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and children’s race, on courses that combine mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and historic architecture in a setting that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes with elevation changes on mountain trails and local roads
A mix of mountain and road running
Natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage
additional: The event takes place from 19–21 June 2026, with race-kit pickup at Central Square on the day before the race. The programme also includes cultural and social activities, such as creative workshops and concerts. The routes are designed for both mountain and road runners. The event features cultural and environmental activities, community projects, and educational initiatives, offering an opportunity to support the area’s natural and cultural heritage.

name: Maratonul Roșia Montană - Cursa Copiilor ~ 2026
description: Maratonul Roșia Montană este o sărbătoare a naturii, istoriei și patrimoniului cultural, desfășurată în inima Munților Apuseni, în comuna Roșia Montană. Traseele variate, ce includ cărări montane, drumuri comunale și porțiuni asfaltate, oferă o experiență unică atât alergătorilor montani, cât și celor de alergare stradală. Evenimentul include curse pentru toate vârstele, inclusiv Cursa Copiilor, care se desfășoară pe trasee adaptate pe categorii de vârstă, în centrul istoric al localității. Participanții pot admira pe parcurs peisajele naturale și patrimoniul arhitectural vechi de secole.

name: Crosul Hoia
description: Crosul Hoia GlobalLogic este o cursă de alergare organizată în Cluj-Napoca, care oferă participanților oportunitatea de a alerga pe potecile răcoroase din Pădurea Hoia. Evenimentul include probe de 15 km, 7 km, 3 km și o probă dedicată familiilor, fiind potrivit pentru alergători de toate vârstele și nivelurile. Organizatorii Runners Club promovează o atmosferă prietenoasă și susțin comunitatea locală de alergători. Crosul are loc în iunie, schimbând asfaltul urban cu natura și oferind o experiență de alergare în aer liber.

name: Urlea Super Vertical
location: Sat. Breaza, Com. Lisa, Jud. Brașov
description: Urlea Super Vertical este o cursă montană extremă, ce se desfășoară în peisajele sălbatice ale Munților Făgăraș, oferind o experiență unică de alergare verticală și coborâre intensă. Este prima și singura ștafetă sus-jos din România, unde un partener urcă și celălalt coboară, adăugând un element inovator și spectaculos competiției. Traseul de 12 km cu o diferență de nivel de 1833 m pune la încercare atât rezistența, cât și tehnica alergătorilor, pe drum forestier, poteci prin păduri și pășuni alpine. Evenimentul este dedicat celor care caută adrenalină pură și o provocare montană intensă, cu un sistem revoluționar de premiere care recompensează performanța individuală și pe echipe.

name: Maratonul Târnavei
description: Maratonul Târnavei este un eveniment de trail running organizat de Asociația Târnăveni Cycling în colaborare cu Ruck Ventilatoare, desfășurat în municipiul Târnaveni, județul Mureș. Ajuns la a 10-a ediție, maratonul promovează un stil de viață sănătos și alergarea în natură, având ca scop creșterea educației ecologice și conștientizarea beneficiilor sportului în aer liber. Startul și finish-ul sunt amplasate în incinta companiei Ruck Ventilatoare, iar competiția include mai multe trasee de trail running pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile. Evenimentul reunește o comunitate de sportivi pasionați de alergare și respect față de mediul înconjurător.

name: Зелените пирамиди 2026 - бягане и колоездене
organizer: Колездачен клуб „Берое“ и Творчески колектив „На улицата“
description: Green Pyramids 2026 is the third edition of a running and cycling event held in Bedечka Park and on the southern slopes of Sredna Gora near Stara Zagora. The event offers a range of distances for children and adults, including a trail half marathon, and is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival. The courses pass by the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the Green Pyramids and are suitable for different fitness levels. Participants receive a race pack with a race number and course support.
course_highlights: 21 km trail half marathon passing the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the “Green Pyramids”
Cross-country cycling routes of 21, 33 and 65 km near the city
Routes of varying difficulty, suitable for all fitness levels
additional: Participation is free for children up to 12 years old. The event is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival, June 19–21, in Bedечka Park. The 33 km route is ridden twice for the 65 km distance. The 33 km and 65 km routes are part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation’s Bulgaria Cup, with different categories. The festival includes sporting competitions, workshops, music, cinema and food; a new location has been added—the Cypress Grove.

name: Национален шампионат
description: The XVI Bulgarian National Folklore Championship “Euro Folk 2026” takes place in Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria. This is a traditional event organized by the European Association of Folklore Festivals (EAFF), with the aim of preserving, developing, and promoting Bulgarian and European folklore through festivals and competitions. The championship includes various categories such as dance, choirs, songs, orchestras, and customs, with an emphasis on authentic and arranged folklore performances. The event is part of EAFF’s long-standing tradition and is held annually in the historic Bulgarian capital, Veliko Tarnovo.

name: ISKRA Trail Kosmaj
description: Iskra Kosmaj Trail is a trail race held on the beautiful Mount Kosmaj, giving participants the chance to enjoy dense forests and stunning views. The race is a great opportunity for a day out and socializing in the race village, located in the start and finish area. Three distances are available, and the race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers of all ages, with parental consent required for participants under 18. The organizer guarantees safety and a great atmosphere, and participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt if they register on time.

name: IAU 6,12,24 ÓRÁS, 50 ÉS 100KM VERSENY
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, 50 km, Félmaraton, 16.6 km, 7.7 km, 3.75 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: PIRIN RUN
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers several distances for skyrunning and mountain-running enthusiasts, with impressive views and challenging terrain. Participants can enjoy a unique experience in Bulgaria’s natural surroundings, combining sport and adventure. The event takes place in Bansko and attracts runners from around the world.

name: XL kmrun - Парк Врана
description: XL Vrana is a race on the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun and held in Vrana Park in Sofia. The course is well known and consists of a loop approximately 5 km long with minimal elevation gain. Participants can choose between three distances—short (5 km), medium (10 km), and long (15 km)—making it suitable for runners of different levels.

name: Шуменско плато 2026
description: Shumensko Plateau 2026 is a race taking place on June 21, 2026, in Shumensko Plateau Nature Park. The start and finish are near the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State in the city of Shumen. Organized by Ilchov Bair Cycling Club, the event features cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running. Participants compete on different courses and are required to follow safety and environmental protection rules. The race is suitable for enthusiasts of mountain biking and running in natural surroundings.

name: Noćni maraton
organizer: Tletsko rekreativni klub “Fruška gora” – Novi Sad
description: The Novi Sad Night Marathon is one of the most popular races in Serbia and a unique nighttime athletics and recreational event. The main race is a 42 km marathon that requires dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and brings a special nighttime race atmosphere. There is also a mini marathon for children and Nordic walking, making the event accessible to all ages and fitness levels. The race has become a tradition and a source of pride for Novi Sad, with carefully organized race packages and a rich program on the course and after the race.

name: Mala Sveta Gora
description: The Mala Sveta Gora running race takes place in the beautiful setting of Ovčar Banja and offers three running categories: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). The race is known for its challenging course through nature, offering runners a unique experience and the chance to compete over different distances. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take advantage of promotional prices and take part in this sporting event, which brings together runners from across the region.

name: TORNIK RACE 2026
description: Tornik Race is a unique running adventure on Zlatibor that combines adrenaline-fueled challenges with nature conservation. The races are suited to all ages and ability levels, with 6 km, 15 km and 25 km courses, as well as children’s races. Participants can enjoy the natural beauty of Tornik, test their endurance and contribute to environmental protection through the Plogging Race. The organizers aim to build a community of passionate runners and nature lovers, offering an unforgettable experience and a healthy sporting spirit.

name: 32. DECATHLON Futóest
description: A 32. Decathlon Futóest egy különleges éjszakai futóverseny Budapest szívében, a kivilágított Hősök terén és az Andrássy úton. A futók negyedmaratoni, félmaratoni, páros és trió távokon mérhetik össze erejüket, miközben élvezhetik a város varázslatos éjszakai atmoszféráját. Az eseményen több ezer futó vesz részt az ország számos településéről, és minden résztvevőt egyedi befutóérem és befutócsomag vár. A verseny 2026. június 27-én este 21:00-kor kezdődik, így a futók a város fényei között élhetik át a futás élményét.

name: KIPRUN FUTÓEST
description: A 32. Decathlon Futóest egy különleges éjszakai futóverseny Budapest szívében, a kivilágított Hősök terén és az Andrássy úton. A futók negyedmaratoni és félmaratoni távokon élvezhetik a város varázslatos hangulatát, ahol a történelem és a sport találkozik. Az eseményen több ezer futó vesz részt az ország számos településéről, és egyedi befutóéremmel várják a résztvevőket. A verseny ideális választás mindazoknak, akik szeretnék átélni a nyári éjszakai futás élményét egy ikonikus helyszínen.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: A Törökbálinti Hendikep egy barátságos, önkéntes nevezési díjas futóverseny, amely a Dióskertben kerül megrendezésre. A versenyzők a félmaraton távját négy kör teljesítésével érhetik el, de lehetőség van kevesebb kör lefutására is. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, ahol minden indulót almával, meleg teával és forralt borral várnak, valamint emlékérmet kapnak a résztvevők. Az első három helyezett férfi és női versenyző egyedi érmet is kap, az eredményhirdetés pedig 12:00-kor zajlik.

name: Holló a Kövön, Várfutás - Palóc TM Kupa
Rodnei Sky Race
description: Rodnei Sky Race este o competiție montană de alergare desfășurată în Munții Rodnei, în zona Borșa, Maramureș. Evenimentul oferă trei trasee distincte, adaptate pentru diferite niveluri de experiență: traseul Puzdrelor, cel mai dificil, destinat alergătorilor experimentați; traseul Gărgălău, o provocare medie pentru alergători pregătiți; și traseul Musceta, un traseu rapid cu diferență mare de coborâre. Cursa face parte din Circuitul Carpaților și pune accent pe experiența alergării în natură, printre peisaje montane spectaculoase. Organizatorii invită familiile și pasionații de sporturi montane să participe la un weekend activ în aer liber.

name: Sinaia Mountain Run
description: Sinaia Mountain Run by Constantina Diță este o cursă montană spectaculoasă cu startul și sosirea în Piața Primăriei Sinaia. Traseele trec prin zone pitorești precum Cota 1000 și Cota 1400, oferind alergătorilor o experiență montană autentică și provocatoare. Evenimentul este deschis atât alergătorilor de elită, cât și pasionaților de alergare montană, cu curse de 10K și 21K. Participanții primesc kit de concurs cu număr, chip de cronometrare și medalie, iar organizatorii oferă galerii foto digitale gratuite.

name: CROSUL ORASULUI MIOVENI 1485
description: Crosul Orașului Mioveni este un eveniment sportiv anual organizat de Asociația Invictus Mioveni în parteneriat cu Primăria și Centrul Cultural al orașului Mioveni. Evenimentul reunește alergători de toate vârstele, de la copii de 3 ani până la seniori de 78 de ani, pe trasee variate de 2,5 km, 5 km și 10 km, plus curse speciale pentru cei mici. Atmosfera este vibrantă, cu muzică, aplauze, demonstrații SMURD și momente artistice, oferind o zi dedicată sănătății, comunității și distracției sportive. Crosul este o sărbătoare a mișcării și a spiritului comunitar, susținută de sponsori importanți precum TEMAD, WD-40 România și UHU România.

name: CROSUL HOIA FORTECH
description: Crosul Hoia GlobalLogic este o cursă de alergare organizată în Pădurea Hoia, Cluj-Napoca, care oferă participanților oportunitatea de a alerga pe poteci răcoroase în natură. Evenimentul include probe de 15 km, 7 km, 3 km și o probă dedicată familiilor, fiind potrivit pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de pregătire. Organizatorii Runners Club promovează o atmosferă prietenoasă și susțin comunitatea locală de alergători. Crosul este o ocazie excelentă de a schimba asfaltul urban cu aerul curat și peisajele frumoase ale pădurii.

name: Crosul Oraşului Mioveni 1485 - Ed. a - IV - a ~ 2026
description: Crosul Orașului Mioveni este un eveniment sportiv organizat de Invictus România, dedicat promovării spiritului de solidaritate și curaj, în special în rândul militarilor răniți. Evenimentul are loc în centrul civic al orașului Mioveni și face parte dintr-o serie de competiții sportive cu caracter caritabil și comemorativ. Participanții sunt încurajați să se alăture pentru a susține valorile de onoare și respect, într-un cadru prietenos și motivant.

name: OK Trip Trail
description: OK Trip Trail is a race held in the beautiful setting of Ovčar Banja, known for its natural beauty and healthy lifestyle. The race brings together sports and nature enthusiasts, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy a challenging course through forested areas and mountain terrain. The Festival of a Healthy Spirit, under whose auspices the race is organized, promotes an active and healthy lifestyle in the heart of Serbia.

name: Rácalmás Szigetfutás
description: A Rácalmási Szigetfutás egy családias jellegű terepfutó verseny, amely Rácalmás festői környezetében, a természetvédelmi oltalom alatt álló Nagy-szigeten és a Duna partján zajlik. A változatos terep árnyas erdei ösvényeket, szántóföldi panorámát, folyóparti útvonalakat és aszfaltos szakaszokat kínál, minimális szintemelkedéssel. A rendezvény célja az egészséges életmód népszerűsítése, minden korosztály számára elérhető sportlehetőségek biztosítása, legyen szó futásról, gyaloglásról vagy kerékpározásról. A verseny központja a történelmi Jankovich Kúria, amely ideális helyszín a rajt és cél számára, valamint a kísérő programoknak. A résztvevőket egyedi érmek és pólók várják, a rendezvény pedig barátságos, természetközeli hangulatot kínál.

name: Крос-триатлон „По стъпките на траките“
description: The “In the Footsteps of the Thracians” cross triathlon is the inaugural edition of a race offering a unique experience in the mystical Valley of the Thracian Kings near Koprinka Reservoir, Kazanlak. Participants will take on challenging swimming, cycling, and running courses amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The event is suitable both for amateurs looking to test their strength and willpower and for those seeking outdoor fun. Organized by the Trayana-Triathlon Sports Club of Stara Zagora, the race promises unforgettable views and an atmospheric experience.

name: Витоша 100км
description: Vitosha 100 km is a mountain ultramarathon held around Vitosha Mountain in 9 stages, passing through picturesque villages and natural landmarks. The race offers a challenge for runners, cyclists, and duathletes, combining long distances with varied terrain. The organizers emphasize protecting nature and holding a zero-waste race. Participants receive race packs and special surprises, and the event is supported by local partners and sponsors.

name: 10. Ócsai Pincesorfutás Radics József emlékére 4 / 12 / 24
description: Az Ócsai Pincesorfutás Radics József emlékére egy közösségi terepfutó esemény, amely Ócsa városának nevezetességein vezet keresztül. A verseny 10,5 km-es távon zajlik, amelyet többször is meg lehet ismételni a hosszabb távokon, így 21 km és 42 km is választható. A futás egyedi chipes időméréssel történik, és a verseny célja a sport és a közösség összekapcsolása Radics József emlékének tiszteletére. A rajt és cél az Egressy Gábor Szabadidőközpont előtt van, és a pálya változatos aszfaltos és földes útvonalakat tartalmaz.

name: Tara Ultra Trail 2026
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail 2026 is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Bajina Bašta, on the first weekend of July. The race offers several distances suited to different fitness levels, from a vertical climb to an ultra-long 62 km course with significant elevation gain. The routes pass through hidden and scenic parts of Tara, giving runners an unforgettable experience of nature and a challenge for body and mind. In addition to the races, an all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events take place at the finish, creating a unique atmosphere for participants and visitors alike.

name: Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships
organizer: Balkan Mountaineering Union (BMU), Planinarski savez Srbije (PSS), Tara Ultra Trail, Planinarski klub Tara
description: The first Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships will be held from July 2 to 4, 2026, in Tara National Park and Bajina Bašta, Serbia. The competition includes four races: Mountain Uphill, Mountain Classic, Mountain Trail, and U18 Mountain Classic, bringing together the best mountain runners in the Balkans. The courses are varied and challenging, with spectacular scenery and technical climbs, offering a true test and an enjoyable experience in nature. The organizers are the Balkan Mountaineering Union, the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, Tara Ultra Trail, and Tara Mountaineering Club. We invite all runners to join us and celebrate mountain and trail running in the heart of Serbia.

name: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA – VISEGRÁD
description: A TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA - VISEGRÁD egy 220 km-es terep váltóverseny, amely összeköti a történelmi Selmecbányát és Visegrádot. A verseny 18 szakaszból áll, melyek a Selmeci-hegységen és a Duna-Ipoly Nemzeti Parkon keresztül vezetnek, gazdag természeti és kulturális látnivalókkal. A futók különböző csapatméretekben és egyéni kategóriákban indulhatnak, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A verseny célja a két királyi város összekapcsolása, valamint a régió természeti és történelmi értékeinek bemutatása.

name: IX. Holdfény Éjszakai Félmaraton és Családi Sportnap
description: A IX. Holdfény Éjszakai Félmaraton és Családi Sportnap egy jótékonysági futóverseny Szegeden, amely éjszakai félmaraton távon várja a futókat. A rendezvény családbarát sportnapként is szolgál, ahol a résztvevők élvezhetik a közösségi sportolás örömét. A verseny helyszíne a Népkert sor, amely ideális környezetet biztosít a futáshoz és a családi programokhoz egyaránt. A rendezvény hagyományosan nagy népszerűségnek örvend, több mint 1100 résztvevővel.

name: VI. Tapolca Rockwool Trail 8 /  14 km / 22 / 33 / 45
description: A VI. Tapolca Rockwool Trail egy festői futóverseny a Balaton-felvidék csodálatos tájain, Tapolca-Diszel környékén. Az útvonal 80%-ban földútból, szekérútból és ösvényből áll, változatos tereppel és páratlan panorámával várja a futókat. Öt különböző távon lehet indulni, melyek közül a 22 km-ig terjedő távok túrázva is teljesíthetők. A verseny egyedi befutóérmekkel, frissítőpontokkal és meleg étellel várja a résztvevőket, miközben a szervezők környezettudatos, zöld rendezvényt tartanak.

name: TELIHOLDFUTAM
description: A Teliholdfutam egy éjszakai futóverseny Esztergomban, amely a Várhegy, Víziváros és a dunaparti kerékpárút festői útvonalán zajlik. A verseny három távon kínál kihívást: 4 km, 10 km és 15 km, melyek között a 15 km-es táv a Prímás-szigetet is érinti. A futók számára kötelező a fejlámpa vagy más világító eszköz használata, mivel a pálya egyes részei kivilágítatlanok. A rendezvényt az Esztergomi Futóművek Amatőr Sportegyesület szervezi, és az esemény az Ötpróba program pontgyűjtő állomása is egyben.

name: Carpathia Trails
distance_verbose: 100 km, 58 km, 57 km, 50 km, Maraton, 36 km, 23 km, 5 km
description: Carpathia Trails is a mountain running race taking place on July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort in Fundata, crossing three mountain ranges: the Bucegi Mountains, the Leaota Mountains, and the Piatra Craiului Mountains. The event offers six individual race options, ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon, suitable for all experience levels. Participants can enjoy spectacular scenery and a unique experience in nature in a friendly, well-organized setting. Registration is limited and available online until June 23, 2026.
course_highlights: Routes crossing three mountain ranges: Bucegi, Leaota, and Piatra Craiului
Distances ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon
Spectacular natural scenery in the Cheile Grădiștei area
additional: All races start on the same day, July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort, the event’s hub. Registration is limited and available online. The organizer may award wildcards to recognized athletes. The event is supported by participant donations, sponsors, and partners. The code of conduct is mandatory for all participants to protect the trails and ensure safety. Participation is through an online form, with limited registration and the possibility of wildcards for recognized athletes. The event takes place on July 4, 2026, in Cheile Grădiștei, Fundata, Brașov.

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run este o competiție de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în Masivul Cozia, pe malul stâng al Oltului, în stațiunea balneoclimaterică Călimănești-Căciulata. Evenimentul, organizat de Asociația Pegas Triatlon Club cu sprijinul autorităților locale, promovează alergarea montană, tradițiile locale și strângerea de fonduri umanitare.
